title: SG Real Estate Virtual Assistant (PA + Inbound Sales Support)
description:
Experienced Singapore Real Estate Virtual Assistant (Start Immediately)



Personal Assistant and Inbound Sales Support



FULL-TIME | REMOTE | EXPERIENCED CANDIDATES ONLY



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Singapore real estate Personal Assistant who can work independently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.



This role is not suitable for beginners or applicants without prior experience supporting Singapore real estate agents.



The ideal candidate is:



- Fast and efficient

- Proactive and responsive

- Comfortable working under pressure

- Able to manage multiple priorities

- Independent and resourceful

- Accountable and reliable



We value speed, accuracy, initiative, and responsibility.



Key Responsibilities



Lead Management and Sales Support



- Respond promptly to buyer and seller enquiries.

- Qualify leads and record client requirements.

- Coordinate viewings and meetings.

- Follow up with prospects, existing clients, and past enquiries.

- Maintain lead trackers and CRM systems.

- Coordinate co-broking arrangements with other property agents.



Singapore Real Estate Administration



- Manage HDB resale timelines, OTP records, and document checklists.

- Assist with transaction documents and deadline tracking.

- Upload and update listings on PropertyGuru, SRX, and other platforms.

- Coordinate with bankers, lawyers, photographers, and vendors.

- Organise client records, spreadsheets, and transaction files.

- Familiarity with PropNex systems is an advantage.



Marketing and Operations



- Coordinate property marketing activities.

- Upload and schedule social media content.

- Liaise with video editors and marketing vendors.

- Track property advertisements and enquiries.

- Maintain daily schedules and appointment reminders.



Daily Personal Assistant Support



- Prioritise urgent tasks independently.

- Provide daily progress updates.

- Ensure leads, appointments, and deadlines are not missed.

- Identify pending matters and follow up proactively.

- Support daily business operations without constant reminders.



Mandatory Requirements



- At least 1 year of direct experience as a Singapore real estate agent’s PA or Virtual Assistant.

- Familiarity with Singapore HDB resale processes and property transaction workflows.

- Experience using PropertyGuru, SRX, or similar Singapore property platforms.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to manage multiple urgent assignments in a fast-moving environment.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Good problem-solving and learning ability.

- Confidence communicating with clients and property agents.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, WhatsApp, and Google Drive.

- Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and quiet workspace.



Candidates without Singapore real estate PA experience will not be shortlisted.



Working Arrangements



- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- 100% remote, based in the Philippines.

- Singapore working hours, GMT+8.

- Occasional Saturday or Sunday coverage for viewing coordination, based on agreed schedules.

- Long-term position with growth opportunities.



Salary



SGD $600–$1,000+ per month, depending on experience, capability, and performance.



Performance-based incentives may be offered.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV and Video intro 1min-2min of the details of your previous Singapore real estate PA experience and your daily workflow. 

2. The number of years you have supported Singapore property agents.

3. The Singapore property platforms and systems you have used.

4. The HDB resale & Pte resale transaction tasks you have handled independently.

5. A short video introduction in English.

6. Your expected monthly salary.



Screening Question



Describe a situation where you managed multiple urgent tasks for a Singapore real estate agent. How did you prioritise and complete them?



We are looking for a dependable, fast-moving PA who can take ownership of the work and grow with our business.

title: Video Editor
description:
Part-Time | Remote | £6 per hour



About the Role

We are recruiting on behalf of a growing UK-based marketing business seeking an experienced and creative Video Editor to produce engaging short-form content for a range of service-based businesses.

This role is primarily focused on creating high-quality videos for platforms including Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You'll work from clear briefs and reference examples to produce content that captures attention, retains viewers, and delivers a professional finish.



You'll be provided with detailed project briefs, examples of the desired editing style, and all the assets needed to complete each project. We're looking for someone who can take ownership of the editing process and consistently deliver content with minimal supervision.



Note: This is not an entry-level editing role. We are looking for an experienced editor who understands social media, storytelling, and audience retention.



Working Hours

Part-Time | Flexible Working Hours

10 hours per week. Work can be completed around agreed deadlines, with flexibility to suit both parties.



Key Responsibilities



Video Editing

Edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Produce high-quality edits typically between 30–90 seconds

Follow detailed creative briefs and reference examples

Deliver polished videos ready for publishing

Ensure all edits align with brand guidelines and project objectives



Motion Graphics & Visual Effects

Create animated captions and subtitles

Add motion graphics and visual effects

Incorporate smooth transitions, zooms, and camera movements

Integrate music and sound effects to enhance engagement

Apply creative editing techniques that maximise audience retention



Project Management

Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously

Deliver projects within agreed deadlines

Implement revisions where required

Maintain organised project files and workflows

Communicate progress and timelines effectively



Content Optimisation

Create edits designed specifically for social media performance

Apply best practices for viewer engagement and retention

Stay up to date with current editing styles and social media trends

Continuously look for ways to improve content quality and performance



Essential Skills & Experience

Proven experience editing short-form social media content

Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

Experience using Adobe After Effects

Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention

Experience creating animated captions, motion graphics, and engaging visual effects

Strong understanding of social media content trends and platform-specific editing styles

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong organisational and time management skills

Excellent written and spoken English



Desirable Skills

Experience using Adobe Photoshop

Experience editing content for marketing agencies or service-based businesses

Familiarity with multiple social media platforms and content strategies

Basic graphic design experience

Experience creating reusable editing templates and workflows



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:

Has several years of professional video editing experience

Takes ownership of projects from start to finish

Produces consistently high-quality work

Requires minimal supervision

Can accurately follow creative briefs

Has a strong eye for detail and design

Understands what makes social media content perform well

Is reliable, organised, and consistently meets deadlines

Continuously looks for ways to improve the quality of their work



What This Role Isn't

Not an entry-level editing position

Not basic video trimming or simple edits

Not someone who requires constant guidance

Not missing deadlines or delivering inconsistent work

Not creating long-form YouTube content



How to Apply

Use "Video Editor" in the subject line of your application.

Send your resume and cover letter.

Include your portfolio or examples of your best short-form video edits.

Please also include your internet speed test result and a screenshot of your laptop or PC specifications.

If you're an experienced video editor with a passion for creating engaging social media content and can consistently deliver high-quality edits with minimal supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

Can start immediately

description:

Salary: $2,500 USD per month | Full-time | Work-From-Home



ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We are Intent Brands USA

Website:

Website:

: 



Our product line, SurviveX First Aid, is scaling aggressively. We are looking for a hands-on
 & SMS Marketing Specialist to own our
 and SMS marketing in Klaviyo, from planning and writing to building, checking, and improving it.



This is a hands-on role, not just a strategy or reporting role. You should be comfortable working independently and turning ideas into messages that help customers buy, come back, and stay engaged.



This is not a high-level advisory or reporting-only role. We need someone who loves getting into the platform, working independently, and turning ideas into compelling messages that drive orders, repeat purchases, and customer loyalty. Plus, we have AI tools ready to help you move faster and work smarter.



*****************************************************

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON:



1.) Campaign Execution: Own the campaign calendar and coordinate offers, product launches, and updates with the team.

2.) Copy & Design: Write clear, persuasive copy and create clean, on-brand
 layouts. Build and schedule campaigns directly in Klaviyo (collaborating with a designer when needed, and leveraging AI assistants to support your workflow).

3.) Automated Flows: Build, optimize, and expand core retention flows: Welcome series, Abandoned Checkout, Post-Purchase, Repeat-Purchase, and Win-Back.

4.) Segmentation & Deliverability: Manage segments, exclusions, and list hygiene so the right audience receives the right message. Protect
 deliverability and manage SMS compliance (consent, opt-outs, quiet hours, and frequency capping).

5.) Quality Assurance: Meticulously check links, discount codes, mobile responsiveness, personalization tags, UTM tracking, and flow logic before anything goes live.

6.) Shopify Integration: Partner with our Shopify team to verify custom events, customer data flow, product availability, and the post-click user experience.

7.) Performance Analysis: Report on what's working, what's failing, and what you plan to test next. Focus heavily on actual orders, repeat revenue, and sustainable growth, not vanity metrics like open rates or inflated platform-attributed revenue.



*****************************************************

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



1.) Proven Experience: Demonstrable, hands-on Klaviyo experience scaling Shopify brands, backed by real-world examples you can walk us through.



2.) Exceptional Communication: Strong written English and sharp editorial judgment regarding copy, clean design, and the customer experience.



3.) Autonomy & Troubleshooting: The ability to build campaigns and flows independently, troubleshoot issues on the fly, and thoroughly QA your own work.



4.) Technical Foundation: A firm grasp of data segmentation, consent frameworks, deliverability best practices, and honest attribution measurement.



5.) Reliability: Clear communication, dependable follow-through, and the self-management skills to thrive without daily micromanagement.



*****************************************************

HOW TO APPLY:



1. ) Please submit the link to your CV and Portfolio, relevant work samples



2.) Your current availability, and confirmation that the $2,500 USD monthly budget works for you.



3.) Additionally, please include brief written answers to these three questions:

-What did you personally own in your most recent Klaviyo role?

-Describe one change you made that improved results. What did you measure, over what period, and what else might have affected the outcome?

-How do you check a campaign or flow before it goes live?



4.) REQUIRED: A LOOM VIDEO WALKTHROUGH of Real Previous Work

-Record a short Loom video (ideally 5–8 minutes) walking us through a real campaign and an automated flow you personally worked on.

-Show us the copy, the build, the flow logic/segments, and the performance results.

-Explain what you personally did, why you made those strategic choices, and what you would test or improve next.



Note: Screenshots and exports are welcome; a generic presentation or a hypothetical sample alone is not sufficient.

Confidentiality Notice: Only share work you have full permission to disclose. Redact any sensitive customer data, proprietary client metrics, or account information. Never share passwords or provide direct access to a former client's account. If strict confidentiality prevents you from sharing a useful walkthrough, please explain this upfront so a safe alternative can be agreed upon.



*****************************************************

HIRING PROCESS:



1.) Application Review: We will review your CV, written answers, and Loom video.

2.) Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a brief conversation.

3.) Practical Assessment: A paid, time-boxed practical test (approx. 2–3 hours) using fictional data. The test fee and deadline will be agreed upon before you start. (All test work is strictly for evaluation purposes and will never be used for live marketing).

s, we build meaningful retention engines that help people stay prepared and safe. 



If you're a Klaviyo expert who loves rolling up your sleeves, executing high-converting campaigns, and seeing the direct impact of your work on a rapidly scaling brand, we want to hear from you.

title: Australian Bookkeeper/Payroll
description:
I’m looking for an experienced and reliable Bookkeeper / Xero Specialist to help manage the finances of my Australian healthcare business.



The immediate priority is to catch up on outstanding bookkeeping, reconcile multiple bank accounts, and organise financial records. Once everything is up to date, the role will transition into ongoing bookkeeping support.



Key Responsibilities

Catch up on outstanding bookkeeping and reconcile bank accounts in Xero.

Review and accurately categorise historical financial transactions.

Reconcile transfers between business accounts and entities.

Review business loans, repayments, and other liabilities.

Investigate discrepancies, duplicate transactions, and unexplained payments.

Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoices, and bills.

Maintain accurate financial records and prepare regular reports.

Organise financial documents for BAS and tax reporting.

Identify opportunities to improve Xero processes and bookkeeping procedures.

Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and healthcare-related information.



Requirements

Proven bookkeeping experience with strong hands-on Xero skills.

Experience supporting Australian businesses; healthcare industry experience is an advantage.

Strong knowledge of bank reconciliations, multiple entities, loans, and inter-account transfers.

Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Ability to investigate discrepancies and work independently.

Good English communication skills.

BAS preparation experience is desirable.



Ideal Candidate

I’m looking for someone who can take ownership of incomplete or messy accounts, investigate transactions thoroughly, and systematically bring financial records up to date.

Experience working with healthcare providers, medical practices, allied health services, or other healthcare businesses will be highly regarded.

The role includes preparing financial records for BAS and tax reporting, with final review and lodgement handled by my Australian accountant or registered tax agent.



If you are interested, please add your CV link to your application and provide the software system you have actually used.

title: Merchandise Allocator – Australian Fashion Retailer
description:
Merchandise Allocator – Australian Fashion Retailer – Full-Time, Remote



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



Join a well-established, premium Australian womenswear label that sells through its own retail stores and online. You'll report to the Planning Manager and own allocation and replenishment day to day, reading the numbers and recommending what the business should do next. This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role with real exposure to how a premium brand plans and trades, and a clear path into merchandise planning.



HOURS



9am to 5pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Own the model stock and replenishment process across stores and ecommerce (the business runs on AP21)

- Build and refine store tiering, capacity and size profiles, not just apply existing ones

- Run allocations, transfers and consolidations using rate of sale, sell-through, weeks cover and inventory age

- Turn weekly trade into clear actions (what to move, replenish or mark down, and why), including markdown and promotional recommendations

- Go beyond allocation execution: trade analysis, recommendations and markdown input

- Support post-season reviews and ad hoc analysis for the planning team

- Send weekly and monthly sales, stock and allocation reports that lead with recommendations

- Improve and automate manual reports and processes



WHY JOIN



- 100% work from home

- 5% pay rise after 6 months

- Bonus

- A long-term career with a stable, established brand and a clear path into merchandise planning

- Work directly with an experienced planning team, with training on AP21 if you've used a similar system



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

- Fluent English, spoken and written

- Hands-on experience with a retail ERP or merchandise system (e.g. AP21, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Cin7, Retail Pro)

- Proven stock allocation experience with a fashion retailer or department store (e.g. David Jones)

- Strong grasp of retail metrics (sell-through, weeks cover, stock turn, rate of sale, inventory age)

- Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, formulas, reporting)

- Able to work independently and own outcomes end to end

- Available 9am to 5pm Sydney time



Highly regarded:

- AP21 experience

- Building tiering, capacity or replenishment models from scratch

- Automation skills (VBA, Google Apps Script or similar)

- Junior Planner or merchandise planning experience

- Allocating across both retail and ecommerce



THE RIGHT PERSON



You don't just execute allocations, you own them. You read the data, recommend the next move and explain the metrics behind it, and you look for ways to improve the process rather than wait to be told. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short Excel analysis task.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words "Right Stock", attach your CV, and answer these two questions:

1. Which retail ERP or merchandise systems have you used for allocation and replenishment, and what did you own in them day to day?

2. Tell us about a time you used sales and stock data to change what went where (a transfer, replenishment or markdown call). What did you recommend, and what was the result?

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels & TikTok) for Australian Car Detailing Brand
description:
We are a premium vehicle detailing business in Perth, Western Australia. Paint correction, ceramic coating, window tinting. We film a lot in the workshop and we want to post far more than we currently do.

 

You will take the raw footage we send you and turn it into short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. We supply everything. You edit.

 

This is a volume role. We want someone who can turn around 25 to 35 videos a month and keep a consistent look across all of them.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 

Editing raw phone and camera footage into 15 to 45 second vertical videos.

 

Cutting to pace, adding captions and text overlays, colour grading so the paint looks right.

 

Keeping a consistent style across everything so the feed looks like one brand.

 

Turning around a video within 48 hours of us sending the footage.

 

Occasionally cutting a longer piece, a before and after or a customer walkthrough.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

A portfolio of short-form vertical video you have personally edited. Not an agency showreel, your own work.

 

You understand what makes short-form perform, not just how to cut it. Hooks, retention, pacing, why people stop scrolling. We want someone who thinks about the first two seconds, not just the transitions.

 

Fluent with your editing software, whatever it is. Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, we do not mind.

 

Good eye for colour. Our work is paint, and paint has to look right on screen.

 

Reliable internet for moving large files.

 

Automotive or detailing content is a strong plus but not essential.

 

 

PAY

 

$600 to $800 USD per month depending on speed and quality. Paid fortnightly via Wise. Reviewed at three months.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send all four. Anything missing and we will not read it.

 

1. Start your application with the word POLISH.

 

2. A link to your portfolio. Three to five short-form videos you edited yourself. Tell us what you did on each one.

 

3. Go to our 
 one video we have posted, tell us which one, and tell us two specific things you would have done differently with it. Be blunt. We are not looking for compliments.

5. How many short-form videos you can comfortably deliver per month, and your monthly rate.

 

6. How many hours a week you are currently committed to other clients.

 

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short clip of our raw footage to edit, so we can see how you handle our material.

title: Graphic tshirt designer
description:
Hi, I’d like to get a fighter walkout T-shirt designed for Kai Xiong, whose fight name is Kobra Kai.



**Important: No AI-generated artwork or AI-generated design elements.** I want original, human-created artwork, with the cobra illustration and typography designed by the artist. Please avoid AI-generated graphics, stock illustrations and generic templates. The final design should be professionally illustrated and supplied in print-ready vector format.



**Direction:**

• White oversized, heavyweight T-shirt

• Clean but intimidating, with the feel of a proper fighter walkout piece

• Inspired by the 80s martial arts aesthetic and vintage fight posters.

• Main colours: black and deep red, with white as the base

• An aggressive, striking cobra graphic rather than anything cartoonish

• Should feel like Kai’s own fighter identity, not generic Cobra Kai merchandise



**Front:**

Keep it relatively minimal, with small KOBRA KAI branding or a cobra emblem, possibly incorporating KAI XIONG.



**Back:**

This can be the main statement piece. I’m thinking a large, aggressive cobra illustration with KOBRA KAI as the main typography. We could incorporate “SINGAPORE” and the slogan “WITNESS THE RISE” if they fit naturally into the composition.



The concept should represent Kai’s comeback after a long layoff and a loss, while building towards his bigger goal of reaching the UFC. It should feel like the beginning of a new chapter in his career, not just a T-shirt for one fight.



Overall, the T-shirt should be badass, bold and recognisable from a distance, especially under arena lighting, while still being something fans would genuinely want to wear outside of fight night.



Feel free to explore the composition, typography and graphic placement while keeping the design clean, distinctive and true to Kai’s identity.

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: USD $1,800–2,300 per month, depending on experience

🌍 Location: Fully remote

🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required)



🎁 What You Get

Your monthly rate is only half the package. You'll also get:

  4 weeks of paid time off

  Performance bonuses tied to results

  A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

  A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

  A team ready to run the services you design, and the training to make that happen

  Close work with our Director of Service Operations

  A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well. You'll design new services, prove they work, turn them into processes a team can run, and maintain their quality over time. Link building is your core strength, and you bring a full understanding of SEO, so you can help build services across the whole picture.



Some examples of what we want to build:

  New types of link building beyond what we offer today

  Our own sites for link placement

  Buying expired and auction domains, then restoring them

  Link exchange programs run at scale



Your day-to-day:

  Build new services: find and design new SEO services we can sell and deliver

  Expand our offer: turn opportunities in Local SEO, GEO, AI visibility, listicles and Digital PR into services we can deliver at scale

  Grow the publisher network: build strong publisher relationships, negotiate prices, and run outreach at scale

  Protect link quality: set vetting standards that go beyond DR and traffic, and keep risky or spammy sites out of our network

  Shape link strategy: define best practice for anchor text mix, link velocity, relevance and target page selection

  Audit and analyze: run backlink audits and competitor link gap analysis to find new opportunities

  Apply the full SEO picture: work with our Director of Service Operations to bring on-page and technical knowledge (site speed, keyword targeting, site health) into how we vet sites and shape new services

  Set content standards: define briefs and quality bars for placement content, including how to spot low-quality AI content

  Systemize: turn each service into a repeatable process with SOPs and quality checks

  Train the people who run those services

  Maintain: monitor quality and results, fix what breaks, and update processes as SEO changes

  Measure: track links that stay live and get indexed, how long they last, and their impact on rankings and AI visibility

  Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  Deep, hands-on SEO experience, with real strength in off-page and link building

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

  Experience with domain auctions, expired domain vetting and site restoration

  Hands-on skill with Ahrefs and Semrush, plus outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Hunter

  Proof that you have built a service or process from scratch and kept it running well over time

  Experience leading or training a team

  Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

Have an agency or link-selling background

Have experience with domain marketplaces and expired domain tools

Are comfortable with numbers: cost per link, margins and capacity planning



🎯 Your First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  Learn our current services, publisher network and quality standards

  Audit our off-page processes and present your top improvement opportunities

  Propose at least one new service with a clear plan, cost model and SOP

  Launch that service as a pilot, with a team trained to run it



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same steps:

1. Application + portfolio. For two or three services, processes or link projects you built, tell us what you made and what your role was, how it performed (links live, indexed, retention, rankings, margins), and what you learned and would do differently.

2. First interview with MJ, our Head of Operations. A conversation about your experience, how you vet link quality, your grasp of on-page and technical SEO basics, and how you turn an idea into a process a team can run.

3. Final interview with our CEO and COO. A deeper conversation on how you would build and pilot a new service, and how you work within agreed standards.



📬 How to Apply (Follow These Steps Precisely)

Please
 the following to 
 with the subject: "SEO Manager – I'm [Your Name] and I Build SEO Services That Scale"

Include:

   1. Your resume with two professional references

   2. Your portfolio, with results for two or three services, processes or link projects you built (what you made, how it performed, and what you learned)



Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

title: E-commerce Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role



EVORETRO is looking for a results-driven and strategic Marketing Manager to lead and oversee all end-to-end marketing operations across our e-commerce platforms, digital marketing channels, social media, paid advertising, influencer partnerships, and events.



This role is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies aligned with the company's business goals, managing the performance of the marketing team, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring that all marketing activities contribute to brand awareness, customer engagement, traffic, and revenue growth.



The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, capable of leading a team of specialists, managing multiple marketing initiatives, monitoring performance metrics, and continuously improving marketing processes and results.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Marketing Strategy & Department Management

- Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies, campaigns, and initiatives aligned with company objectives.

- Oversee the entire marketing department, including planning, execution, performance monitoring, and reporting.

- Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, priorities, and timelines for each function.

- Lead, supervise, and evaluate the performance of marketing team members and specialists.

- Manage workloads, delegate responsibilities, set priorities, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

- Establish standardized workflows, processes, and reporting systems to improve departmental efficiency.

- Coordinate with executive leadership and other departments to align marketing initiatives with sales, product launches, and overall business priorities.



2. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

- Lead and oversee the performance of eBay and Walmart marketplace accounts, working closely with the E-commerce Account Specialists.

- Ensure effective marketplace strategies for product listings, promotions, pricing coordination, visibility, conversion, and sales growth.

- Monitor marketplace performance, product rankings, traffic, conversion rates, and revenue.

- Collaborate with the team on product launches, listing optimization, merchandising, and marketplace-specific campaigns.

- Coordinate with supply chain, inventory, and operations teams to support product availability and promotional planning.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketplace performance and expand the company's online sales channels.



3. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Supervise the Digital Marketing Specialist and oversee the execution of digital marketing campaigns.

- Lead marketing initiatives across Meta Ads and other relevant digital advertising channels.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

- Ensure campaigns are properly planned, tested, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

- Oversee audience targeting, retargeting, campaign testing, and performance optimization.

- Use analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and recommend improvements.



 4. Social Media & Content Marketing

- Oversee social media strategy, content planning, publishing schedules, and audience engagement across relevant platforms.

- Guide the Social Media Specialist in creating content that supports brand awareness, product promotion, and customer engagement.

- Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, tone, and marketing communications.

- Coordinate content calendars, campaign assets, product announcements, and promotional activities.

- Monitor social media performance, audience growth, engagement rates, and referral traffic.

- Ensure social media initiatives support the broader marketing and e-commerce strategies.



5. Influencer & Partnership Marketing

- Lead the overall influencer marketing strategy, including creator identification, outreach, collaboration planning, and campaign execution.

- Oversee influencer partnerships, product seeding, sponsored content, affiliate initiatives, and brand collaborations.

- Establish campaign objectives, deliverables, budgets, and performance indicators.

- Monitor influencer campaign results, including reach, engagement, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue where measurable.

- Build and maintain relationships with influencers, content creators, and strategic marketing partners.



6. Shopify & Website Marketing

- Oversee Shopify-related marketing initiatives in coordination with the responsible team members.

- Ensure the website supports marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions, and customer acquisition goals.

- Monitor website traffic, conversion rates, customer behavior, and sales performance.

- Coordinate website content updates, landing pages, promotional banners, product merchandising, and conversion optimization.

- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, user experience, and online store performance.

- Collaborate with relevant teams on SEO,
 marketing, and customer retention initiatives, as applicable.



7. Events & Brand Activations

- Plan, coordinate, and oversee marketing events, trade shows, industry exhibitions, product showcases, and brand activations.

- Manage event objectives, budgets, timelines, logistics, promotional materials, and team assignments.

- Coordinate with internal departments, event organizers, vendors, influencers, and external partners.

- Ensure events support brand awareness, lead generation, partnerships, customer engagement, and sales opportunities.

- Evaluate event performance and prepare post-event reports with recommendations for future activities.



 8. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Establish and monitor KPIs for the marketing department and its individual functions.

- Consolidate reports covering marketplace sales, advertising performance, website conversions, social media engagement, influencer campaigns, and event results.

- Analyze marketing data to identify opportunities, challenges, and areas for improvement.

- Present regular performance updates, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

- Ensure marketing activities are evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, not just completed tasks.

- Recommend adjustments to strategies, budgets, and resource allocation based on performance data.



9. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and executive leadership to align marketing activities with company goals.

- Coordinate promotional calendars, product launches, inventory availability, campaign requirements, and budget approvals.

- Ensure clear communication, accountability, and timely execution across marketing functions.

- Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to departmental processes and collaboration.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

- At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience managing marketing campaigns and leading people or teams.

- Proven experience overseeing multiple marketing functions, preferably in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or a similar business environment.

- Experience with eBay and Walmart marketplace operations or marketplace account management.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, paid advertising, Meta Ads, social media management, influencer marketing, and content strategy.

- Working knowledge of Shopify and e-commerce website performance optimization.

- Experience planning and managing marketing events, partnerships, or brand activations.

- Proficiency in marketing analytics, KPI tracking, budget management, and performance reporting.

- Strong leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead remote teams, and ensure accountability across different marketing functions.

- Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on business results, continuous improvement, and return on investment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on agreed targets, including:



- Marketing-attributed revenue growth and contribution to overall sales.

- E-commerce marketplace sales, conversion rates, and account performance.

- Paid advertising efficiency, ROAS, and customer acquisition cost.

- Website traffic, conversion rates, and Shopify store performance.

- Social media growth, engagement, and referral traffic.

- Influencer campaign performance and measurable business outcomes.

- Event execution, budget adherence, and lead or partnership generation.

- Achievement of marketing campaign deadlines, budgets, and objectives.

- Team productivity, quality of deliverables, and achievement of individual KPIs.

- Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and cross-department coordination.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a strategic marketing leader who understands how different marketing functions work together to drive business growth. They can guide specialists, establish clear priorities, manage budgets, interpret performance data, and take ownership of the department's overall results.



This person should be comfortable managing both the strategic direction and operational execution of marketing activities while building a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team.

title: Website design
description:
# Freelance Website Designer & Developer for Combat Sports Promotion (Fixed Price)



**Project: Reign Championship | Singapore**



## About the project



Reign Championship is a new combat sports promotion based in Singapore. We are looking for a freelancer to design and build a clean, professional website that establishes our brand and supports our upcoming events.



Our visual identity is bold, modern and premium, using red, black and white. We want a strong combat sports aesthetic with clear typography and impactful visuals.



We will provide our logo, existing designs, event details and available images. We need someone who can help organise the content and refine the website copy.



## Scope of work



Build a mobile-responsive website using an existing platform or theme, such as WordPress or Framer.



The website should include:



1. **Homepage:** Introduction to Reign, our tagline, featured events and clear calls to action.

2. **Events:** An events listing page and individual pages for our 8-Man No-Gi Community Tournament and inaugural event on 19 December 2026 at Suntec City, Singapore.

3. **Partners & Sponsorship:** A page introducing partnership opportunities with a working enquiry form.

4. **Contact:** A simple contact page or enquiry form.

5. **Fighter Registration:** A reusable page with an application form that can remain unpublished until applications open.



The event pages should be reusable so we can add future events without redesigning the website.



## Required deliverables



* Complete website design and setup

* Responsive layouts for mobile and desktop

* Copy refinement and basic content formatting

* Working contact and enquiry forms

* Fighter registration form connected to a spreadsheet or another agreed submission system

* Basic SEO setup

* Domain connection and website launch assistance

* Administrative access and a short handover showing us how to update the site

* Two reasonable rounds of revisions



## Important requirements



* The website must be easy for a non-technical owner to update.

* Reign must retain ownership and administrative access to the website, domain and accounts.

* Please disclose any recurring platform, hosting, plugin or form costs.

* No custom coding or complex features are required at this stage.

* Please share live website examples from your portfolio, preferably sports, events or entertainment brands.



## Budget and application



Our target budget is S$300–450, with a maximum of S$500 excluding domain registration and paid subscriptions.



Please provide:



* Your fixed-price quotation

* Recommended platform and any recurring costs

* Estimated completion timeline

* Links to at least two relevant websites you have built

* Confirmation of what is included and excluded from your quotation



We are looking for someone practical, reliable and design-conscious who can deliver a polished first version without unnecessary complexity.

title: Verification of Benefits Specialist
description:
***THIS POSITION IS NOT LIMITED TO INSURANCE VERIFICATION. PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB POSTING CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.***



Verification of Benefits Specialist

 

The Purpose of Your Role

The Verification of Benefits (VOB) Specialist supports prospective clients with Select Health insurance by verifying eligibility, benefits, and coverage requirements for behavioral health services, including Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP).

 

This role goes beyond initial insurance verification. The specialist follows up on pending requirements, tracks case progress, communicates with Select Health representatives, and coordinates with internal teams to help resolve insurance-related issues and prevent delays in the admissions process.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Maintain 100% accuracy in benefit verification and documentation.

Complete benefit verifications within one hour of receiving a request.

Maintain less than 2% variance between verified benefits and actual payer reimbursement outcomes, where measurable.

Identify and document coverage limitations, authorization requirements, and payer-specific rules.

Follow up on outstanding Select Health requirements and provide timely case updates.





Core Responsibilities

1. Insurance Verification

Verify Select Health eligibility, benefits, and coverage for IOP, PHP, and other applicable behavioral health services.

Document deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, out-of-pocket costs, authorization requirements, exclusions, and coverage limitations. Clarify discrepancies and escalate complex or unclear insurance requirements.



2. Follow-Up and Case Coordination

Track cases beyond initial verification and monitor outstanding insurance requirements.

Follow up with Select Health representatives to obtain updates, clarify requirements, and resolve pending issues.

Coordinate with Admissions, Utilization Review, and the Business Office to help move cases through the insurance process.

Communicate case updates, delays, and next steps to the appropriate team members.

Follow through on outstanding items until resolved or appropriately escalated.



3. Documentation and Compliance

Maintain accurate, organized records of benefits, payer communications, reference numbers, and follow-up activities.

Keep case information current and accessible to authorized team members.

Follow HIPAA requirements and company policies when handling client information.

Identify recurring issues and share opportunities to improve processes and reduce delays.





Qualifications and Skills

Experience in insurance verification, healthcare administration, or benefits coordination preferred.

Familiarity with Select Health and behavioral health insurance requirements is an advantage.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up.

Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate with insurance representatives and internal teams.

Ability to manage multiple cases, track pending items, and escalate issues when needed.





Work Expectations

The VOB Specialist is responsible for more than confirming insurance coverage. This role requires proactive follow-up, ongoing case tracking, and coordination with Select Health and internal teams to help ensure insurance requirements are addressed and cases continue moving forward.



How to Apply



Please submit your updated resume and include the word SELECT in your application to confirm that you have read the full job posting.



Schedule: This position will begin as part-time, with the opportunity to transition to full-time as the role evolves.

title: Senior Business Plan Writer / Strategist & Market Research Analyst
description:
## Senior Business Plan Writer / Strategist & Market Research Analyst

We are seeking a highly skilled, analytical, and detail-driven Proposal & Business Plan Writer to support Live Plan business planning development. 



Position: Business Plan Writer, Business Strategist & Market Research Analyst  

Work Type: Remote   

Experience Required: 4+ Years  

Availability: Consistent Monday–Friday availability required  

Experience Level: Advanced / Senior



## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly skilled Business Plan Writer, Business Strategist, and Market Research Analyst to support the development and evaluation of multiple startup and small-business ventures.



This is not a general administrative VA or entry-level research position.



The ideal candidate is an experienced business research professional who can independently conduct credible market research, analyze industries and competitors, develop comprehensive business and feasibility plans, build financial forecasts, and convert research into professional pitch decks and strategic recommendations.



Strong experience with "LivePlan" is highly preferred.



You must be able to move beyond simply collecting information. We need someone who can analyze the evidence, identify what it means for the business, challenge weak assumptions, and translate research into practical business strategy.



## PRIMARY ASSIGNMENTS



You will assist with the development of:



**1. LivePlan Business Plans**  

Develop comprehensive business plans using LivePlan, including executive summaries, company descriptions, problems worth solving, solutions, target markets, competitive analysis, marketing activities, sales channels, operations, milestones, financial assumptions, and supporting research.



**2. Feasibility Studies**  

Research and evaluate whether proposed businesses, products, services, and projects are commercially viable before significant capital is committed.



**3. Pitch Decks**  

Develop professional, research-supported presentations that clearly communicate the business opportunity, customer problem, solution, target market, competitive advantage, business model, financial outlook, and growth strategy.



**4. Marketing Pitches & Strategy**  

Develop persuasive marketing strategies and business-development materials supported by target-customer, competitive, pricing, industry, and market research.



**5. Financial Forecast & Budget Planning**  

Assist with startup-cost estimates, operating budgets, sales forecasts, revenue assumptions, expense projections, cash-flow planning, break-even analysis, and financial scenarios.



**6. Market Research Reports**  

Produce detailed market research reports covering market size, industry conditions, consumer demand, customer demographics, competitors, pricing, trends, barriers to entry, opportunities, risks, and market feasibility.



## CORE SKILLS REQUIRED



**Business Plan Writing & Strategy:  Advanced ability to transform a business concept and supporting evidence into a structured, professional, and actionable business plan.



**Market Research & Data Analysis: Strong ability to locate, validate, analyze, and interpret market, industry, consumer, competitor, and economic data.



**Financial Forecasting & Business Modeling: Ability to develop realistic startup budgets, revenue projections, expense forecasts, cash-flow assumptions, break-even calculations, and scenario analyses.



Feasibility & Competitive Analysis: Ability to determine market demand, analyze direct and indirect competitors, identify market gaps, evaluate risks, and assess commercial viability.



Pitch Deck & Executive Presentation Development: Ability to convert detailed research and financial information into concise, persuasive, professional presentations for owners, lenders, partners, investors, or other stakeholders.



## PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES



The selected candidate will independently conduct primary and secondary business research; identify credible data sources; analyze industries, competitors, customers, pricing, and market conditions; and prepare professional written reports supported by verifiable evidence.



You will develop and revise LivePlan business plans, feasibility studies, market research reports, marketing strategies, financial forecasts, budgets, and pitch decks.



Research should prioritize credible sources such as government databases, Census data, SBA resources, economic-development agencies, industry associations, company filings, reputable research organizations, academic resources, and established market-data providers when appropriate.



You will be expected to cite and document important research sources so information can be independently verified.



The role also requires reviewing existing business-plan material, identifying unsupported assumptions or research gaps, recommending improvements, and strengthening the evidence supporting major business decisions.



## CPM / PROJECT & TASK MANAGEMENT — REQUIRED



The selected candidate must be capable of independently organizing assignments and maintaining a structured CPM / project-management system.



At the beginning of each project or workweek, you will create a project schedule identifying assignments, priorities, deliverables, deadlines, research requirements, and project status.



You will be responsible for keeping assigned projects organized, updating progress, meeting agreed deadlines, and providing concise weekly completion reports.



Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as CRM software, LivePlan, Airtable, Clockify, microsoft Excel Sheets, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, or comparable project-management systems.**



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Applicants must have at least 4+ years of verifiable professional experience in business-plan writing, business research, market research, strategic planning, financial analysis, feasibility analysis, or closely related work.



Candidates must demonstrate strong professional English writing, analytical reasoning, attention to detail, independent research ability, and the ability to work efficiently without constant supervision.



Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets competency is required for financial modeling and research analysis.



Experience with "LivePlan" is strongly preferred. Experience developing professional PowerPoint or Google Slides presentations is also expected.



Applicants must be able to distinguish credible evidence from unsupported internet content and must not submit fabricated statistics, unverifiable citations, or unreviewed AI-generated research as completed professional work.



AI tools may be used to improve efficiency when appropriate, but all research, calculations, sources, conclusions, and deliverables must be independently reviewed and validated by the candidate.



## PORTFOLIO & EXPERIENCE VERIFICATION



Candidates should be prepared to screen-share or provide examples of previous professional work with confidential client information removed or redacted where necessary.



Examples may include:



**Market Research & Data Analysis: Research reports demonstrating your ability to gather reliable market data, identify industry trends, evaluate target markets, and interpret findings.



**Competitive Analysis: Documentation demonstrating your ability to research competitors, evaluate their positioning and strategies, identify market gaps, and uncover potential business opportunities.



**Business Plans: Comprehensive business plans you have written or substantially contributed to, including executive summaries, market analysis, competitive positioning, business models, marketing strategies, and operational plans.



**Feasibility Studies: Work demonstrating your ability to evaluate market demand, competition, startup and operating costs, risks, financial viability, and overall project feasibility.



**Financial Research & Projections: Startup-cost analyses, revenue forecasts, operating budgets, cash-flow projections, break-even analyses, or other financial models supporting business decisions.



**Pitch Decks & Investor Materials: Presentations demonstrating your ability to synthesize complex information into clear and persuasive materials communicating the opportunity, value proposition, market potential, competitive advantage, strategy, and financial outlook.



**Research Sources & Methodology: During the interview, be prepared to explain the databases, government resources, industry reports, research tools, and methodologies you use to locate and validate business information.



Hired candidate must successfully complete all project & Task 100% and will be Reviewed for unlimited revision if needed. 

Project estimation one-week work period before final payment for Gig.



Hired Candidate will be evaluated on research quality, source credibility, analytical depth, accuracy, financial reasoning, writing quality, organization, speed, communication, and ability to meet deadlines.





## HOW TO APPLY — FILTER QUESTIONS REQUIRED



To be considered, begin your application with the words:



**BUSINESS STRATEGY 2026**



Then answer all of the following questions:



1. How many years of professional experience do you have writing business plans and conducting market research?



2. Have you personally built business plans using "LivePlan"? If yes, approximately how many?



3. Describe the most comprehensive market research or feasibility study you have completed and explain what research you personally performed.



4. What sources or databases do you normally use to obtain reliable market size, industry, demographic, competitor, and economic data?



5. Describe your experience creating financial forecasts, startup budgets, cash-flow projections, and break-even analyses.



6. What software do you use for business plans, financial analysis, research, project management, and pitch-deck development?



7. Provide or be prepared to screen-share 2–3 examples of relevant previous work. Confidential client information may be redacted.



8. Explain how you verify market statistics and financial information before including them in a client report or business plan.



9. willing to complete multiple assignments in one-week time period.



10. What is your expected hourly or weekly compensation for a long-term position?



**Applications that do not answer all screening questions or do not include “BUSINESS STRATEGY 2026” at the beginning may not advance to the interview stage.**



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for more than someone who can fill in business-plan templates.



The right candidate should be capable of receiving a business concept, independently determining what research is needed, finding credible evidence, analyzing the opportunity, developing reasonable financial assumptions, identifying weaknesses and risks, and presenting management with a professional and defensible recommendation.



For a candidate who consistently demonstrates excellent research, accuracy, efficiency, communication, and strategic thinking, this position has the potential to develop into a long-term professional role supporting multiple company projects.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the moment a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

Position Overview

We are seeking a technical and process-driven CRM Operations Specialist to serve as the operational backbone of our sales and marketing efforts. In this non-phone, systems-focused role, you will manage our CRM platform, architect multi-channel buyer workflows, and ensure seamless, bidirectional data flow between systems.. 4. Analytics, Reporting & Enablement

Create standard operating procedures (SOPs), system documentation, and workflow diagrams for cross-functional reference.

Conduct regular system audits to identify process gaps and implement automation improvements.

Requirements & Qualifications

Non-Customer Facing Focus: Strong preference for back-end operational systems, data architecture, and workflow design over phone/sales outreach.

Technical Integration Skills: Solid understanding of data mapping, native app integrations,

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We are a fast growing DTC skincare brand selling premium, ingredient led products to women over 40, across the US and DACH. We are looking for a Social Media Manager to grow our owned channels and to own every conversation happening on them. Buying the ads is not part of this role. Everything people say underneath them is.



Full time. Reports to management.



What You’ll Do

• Own our channels: TikTok, Instagram and
, per market.

• Own the content calendar, the posting and the scheduling.

• Own comments and DMs, including the ones under our ads. Every paid post collects them, and an unanswered comment costs a sale or turns into a dispute. You d
 what gets answered, what gets hidden and what goes to customer service.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience speaking to mature women. Our customer is over 40 and the tone that works on a teenage audience does not work here.

• Organic growth, earned attention. This is not a performance marketing role.

• You are fast on a queue. Comment and DM volume under paid social at our spend level is real daily work, not a side task.

• You can work from existing creative rather than needing a production budget.

• You know which post worked and why.



What to Include in Your Application

• An account you grew, with the starting number, the finishing number and the dates.

• Screenshots from the account itself, not a portfolio deck.

• One post that worked and your explanation of why.

• One giveaway or campaign you ran, and what it brought in.

MUST HAVE

- A clear, natural American English accent

NICE TO HAVE

PRIVACY

HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Coder Calls". We skip applications without it.

title: Finance Manager (Daily Reporting)
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO.



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not.

We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.

The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET):

• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.

Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team

Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger

What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like

Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm
