title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

WHAT YOU’LL DO



Turn raw footage into clean TikTok Shop videos by following our references and instructions.



Our recordings often include multiple takes and camera angles, so you need to identify the correct footage, remove mistakes and unnecessary parts, and turn it into a clean finished edit.



We care most about:



• Choosing the correct/best takes based on references

• Simple zoom-ins, zoom-outs and visual changes when needed

• Following references and instructions accurately

• Checking your own work before submitting



You do NOT need advanced motion graphics, creative strategy, professional sound design or advanced editing skills.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Someone with basic video editing experience who is reliable, detail-oriented and able to learn quickly.



You should already be comfortable with basic editing and preferably CapCut.



Previous editing experience is required, but you do not need to be an advanced editor. Around 1 year of experience is a plus, but strong junior editors with less experience are also welcome to apply.



More importantly, we want someone who can follow clear instructions, learn our workflow, notice mistakes and work independently without constant supervision.



Reliable communication, consistent work and willingness to learn are very important.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



• 40 hours/week

• $475/month base salary

• Up to $50/month performance bonus ($525 total)

• Weekly payments during the first weeks

• 13th-month pay in accordance with applicable Philippine law

• Paid 2-month probationary period

• Stable long-term full-time position

• Potential for higher compensation and more responsibility as we grow



The performance bonus is based mainly on accuracy, work quality, reliability, meeting deadlines, organization and following instructions.



Higher compensation may be available for truly exceptional candidates.



PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short PAID editing test using real raw footage, clear instructions and a reference video.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Your APPLICATION TITLE must begin exactly with:



BLUE MANGO



For example:



BLUE MANGO – Video Editor Application



Applications that do not have BLUE MANGO at the beginning of the application title may not be reviewed.



Then send:



Links to your 2–3 BEST video edits. Short-form examples are preferred, but they do not need to be advanced.



Briefly tell us about your video editing experience, previous relevant work and which editing software you use.



Imagine you receive raw footage with multiple takes, mistakes and pauses, plus a reference video. Briefly explain how you would approach turning it into the finished video.



Confirm that you can reliably commit to 40 hours/week.



Are you currently working for another employer or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



Briefly describe your internet/power reliability and backup setup.



Confirm that $475/month base + up to $50/month performance bonus works for you. If your expected compensation is higher, you may state it.



Our goal is to find a reliable editor who wants to become very good at our workflow and work with us long-term.



We look forward to reviewing your application and hopefully getting to know you better.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer | $500/month | Long-Term, Multiple Channels
description:
We're hiring an experienced YouTube thumbnail designer for a long-term role across our channels. $500 USD/month base, consistent work, clear references, and room to grow.



We own and operate the channels you'll work on. This is an in-house role, not an agency juggling outside clients.



We need someone who can make a viewer stop scrolling and want to click. Strong design skills matter, but so does choosing the right image, creating curiosity, and understanding what interests each channel's audience.



THE WORK



• Create thumbnails across different channels, topics, and visual styles, including gaming, TV, and pop culture.

• Turn video titles and briefs into clear, interesting visual concepts. The thumbnail should add to the title rather than simply repeat it.

• Match each channel's style while making every thumbnail relevant to its specific video.

• Use strong image selection, composition, cutouts, colour, contrast, and readable text where appropriate. Thumbnails need to work at small sizes.

• Work with templates we provide and help build reusable templates or repeatable formulas for additional styles.

• Keep editable source files organised, meet agreed deadlines, and apply feedback to future work.



WORKLOAD AND PAY



The base is $500 USD/month. You'll start with a few thumbnails per working day while learning our channels, templates, and feedback. Volume will increase as you become comfortable, with an eventual target of around 10–12 thumbnails per working day.



That target relies on established templates and repeatable styles. You won't be expected to invent 10–12 completely new designs from scratch every day. Familiar template-based thumbnails can often take around 10–20 minutes; new styles, harder concepts, and revisions can take longer. We build up based on your readiness and consistent quality, not a fixed deadline to hit full volume.



We're happy to show shortlisted applicants the templates and examples before they d
, so you can judge the actual workload yourself.



This role requires exclusive thumbnail work for us while you're on the team: no thumbnail clients outside our business, including competing channels. Please apply only if you're comfortable with this arrangement.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Proven graphic design experience and a strong portfolio of YouTube thumbnails.

• Strong Photoshop skills, or equivalent software that supports professional editing and reusable, editable files.

• Ability to adapt across several styles, rather than only producing one type of thumbnail.

• An understanding of visual hierarchy, curiosity, audience interest, and how titles and thumbnails work together. Attractive design alone isn't enough.

• Good communication, reliable delivery, and the ability to improve from feedback without needing the same corrections repeatedly.

• Someone who can suggest a stronger concept when the brief could be improved.



Examples of the range of thumbnails involved:









WHY JOIN



Fixed monthly income, ongoing work across our own channels, and a repeatable process you can get faster at over time. Strong performers may grow into a thumbnail manager role, helping develop styles, review designs, and guide other designers. Further opportunities depend on your ability and what the business needs; promotion isn't guaranteed.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject: Thumbnail Designer – [Your Name]



Please include:

1. A link to 5–10 of your strongest YouTube thumbnails. Include different styles if possible and explain your contribution to any team work.

2. Choose one thumbnail from your portfolio and briefly explain who it targets, what makes it interesting, and how it works with the video title.

3. Your design software and experience using or building templates.

4. Your availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

5. Confirmation that you're comfortable with $500/month, the gradual increase towards 10–12 thumbnails per working day, and exclusive thumbnail work for us.



If you have performance results for your work, feel free to include them with context. They aren't required. A focused application with relevant examples is more useful than a long generic cover letter.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: Technical QA Engineer (Laravel + Vue 2, post-deploy), EU property-tech + SaaS, remote
description:
Role

We ship small changes to our live platforms often. We want a technical QA engineer with a real developer background: you think like a user, but you can also read the code path, review merge requests, and tell us when the fix or the AI-suggested change should be different. After each release you check that landlords, renters, candidates and companies can still get from A to B to C. You are not the person who builds features full time, but you are close to a half-developer on our stack. Speed and quality, not one at the cost of the other.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We run several live rental and property platforms on one shared Laravel and Vue 2 codebase, plus a recruitment SaaS where candidates record video intakes for companies and agencies. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



Where you sit in our flow

We roll out to production often and we want to keep that pace. Developers deploy; you are not a gate before release and you do not own the deploy button. After each production rollout you test on
 the journeys that release touched, then the critical paths users depend on, on desktop and mobile, with test accounts and safe paths where we need them. You are the second check after go-live, not a blocker in front of it. When something fails for a real user, you report it fast with steps, expected versus actual, and enough detail that a developer can fix it the same day.



How we work

Our developers work with AI coding assistants and keep their changes small. You test the outcome in the browser and you sanity-check the change in GitLab: read the diff, spot risky patterns, and push back when generated code is sloppy or the wrong layer was touched. If something works on paper but feels wrong in the browser, you say so. You may use AI tools yourself, but the pass or fail comes from what you verified, not from what the model claimed.



What you will do

- After each production rollout, smoke-test the journeys that release touched, on desktop and on mobile

- Re-run the critical journeys per product: listing a property, booking a viewing, uploading documents, recording a video intake, reviewing candidates

- Explore beyond the release note when something looks fragile

- Check that a change on one platform did not break or leak into another platform on the same codebase

- Write clear bug reports: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual, severity, environment, browser and device, screenshot or short video

- Point developers to the file, layer, or request: Blade, Vue component, controller, query, or API response

- Give UX feedback in plain words, for example "a landlord would not know what to do here"

- Review merge requests and recent commits: what changed, what could regress, what should have been tested, what you would do differently

- Suggest concrete improvements to developers (and to AI-generated patches): safer query, clearer validation, better error handling, smaller scope



Requirements

- Strong technical background: you have worked as a developer or as QA embedded with developers, and you can read Laravel and Vue 2 code in a real codebase, not only tutorials

- Hands-on experience with Laravel web applications and Vue 2 front ends in production, or equivalent depth with a similar PHP plus SPA stack and a clear plan to work in our Vue 2 patterns

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant products: one codebase, several sites or customers, and you know how a fix on one brand can break another

- Proven QA on live web products, with examples where your report or your review caught something others missed

- You think in user journeys and in the people behind them

- Clear written English, short and precise

- Solid GitLab or GitHub habits: branches, merge requests, reading diffs, commenting on specific lines

- Browser developer tools: console, network tab, status codes; you tie UI symptoms to backend responses

- Comfortable challenging AI-assisted development: you review output like a senior teammate, not like a checklist-only tester

- Reliable and self-directed: you find the next useful check without being told

- This role is QA and review first. We do not hire you primarily to ship features. Occasional tiny fixes are a bonus, not the job description.



Nice to have

- Accessibility basics: keyboard use, contrast, readable forms

- Ideas for light automated checks or regression notes, without making automation the whole role

- Docker-based local setup or Laravel Mix familiarity



Working hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Amsterdam time. That is 15:00 to 23:00 in the Philippines in European summer, and 16:00 to 00:00 when Europe switches to winter time. Please state your timezone and the window you can reliably cover each workday.



Paid trial (before full engagement)

A paid trial week of about five working days, full time, at $3 per hour, tracked with TimeProof after signing. We give you test accounts, a short list of recent rollouts to verify the same way you would after go-live, and read-only visibility on merge requests where useful. You test like a real user on desktop and mobile, file bug reports and UX notes, and add technical review comments where you see risk in the change. You may use AI tools, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you report and every review comment.



The deal

Remote, full time, long term. Hours are tracked with TimeProof. Rate: $3 per hour to start, reviewed on quality and impact. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Start your message with ABC.

2) One bug you found in production that others missed: how you reproduced it and how you reported it.

3) How you would test a release right after it goes live, without slowing every release down.

4) One example of UX feedback you gave that changed a flow.

5) A form submits and nothing happens. What do you send the developer?

6) One merge request or diff you reviewed: what you looked at in the code, what you worried about, and what you asked the developer to change.

7) Your timezone and the Amsterdam-time window you can cover.



Keep it short. Selected applicants do a short video intake on our platform before we talk.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work

- You only know QA in theory and cannot give real examples

- You have never read application code or merge request diffs in a real job

- You only write automated tests and do not think about the people using the product

- You want a pure development role with no testing responsibility

- You cannot write clear English

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools

title: Video Editor & Content Repurposing VA
description:
About Oodleway



Oodleway helps Cavoodle owners raise happy, well-adjusted dogs through practical, breed-specific training and education.



We create educational content, podcast episodes, customer testimonials and video content featuring our founder, Tiana. We're looking for a creative, organised and proactive Video Editor & Content Repurposing VA who can help us get more value from the content we already produce.



You'll work with our existing raw footage, podcast recordings and educational material to create engaging videos, repurpose content across multiple platforms and help prepare everything for publishing.



We're looking for someone who can work independently, identify good content opportunities and take initiative, rather than simply completing tasks we're required to outline in detail.



What You'll Do



1. Short-Form Video Editing



- Turn raw footage into engaging Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

- Edit talking-head videos, educational tips, puppy training footage, customer testimonials and behind-the-scenes content.

- Add music, B-roll, text overlays and simple graphics where appropriate.

- Create engaging hooks and maintain a strong pace to keep viewers watching.

- Suggest creative improvements and new content ideas based on the footage provided.



 2. Podcast Editing & Repurposing



- Edit full podcast episodes recorded in Descript, preparing polished episodes ready for publishing.

- Identify and extract interesting, educational or entertaining moments from longer recordings to create multiple short-form video clips.

- Repurpose podcast episodes into YouTube videos, including preparing the finished video for upload.

- Identify strong clip opportunities and suggest timestamps, hooks and titles.

- Help organise podcast files and prepare episodes for publishing through Kajabi.

- Ensure content is polished, consistent and ready for its intended platform.



3. Written Content & Content Repurposing



- Turn podcast episodes and recordings into written blog posts for Kajabi.

- Repurpose podcast discussions into articles suitable for Substack.

- Transform long-form content into shorter pieces for social media and other platforms.

- Draft social media captions to accompany videos and other content.

- Suggest headlines, hooks and titles that capture attention and communicate the value of our content.

- Use AI tools where appropriate to speed up transcription, drafting and content repurposing, while ensuring the final output is accurate, natural and useful.



**Note:** Social media captions will be reviewed and edited by our founder before publishing. You'll be responsible for preparing the initial drafts.



4. Paid Advertising Creatives



- Edit customer testimonial videos into compelling ads.

- Turn raw footage into promotional videos for our Cavoodle Training Academy and other Oodleway products.

- Create variations of successful ads, testing different opening hooks and creative approaches.

- Include appropriate text overlays and clear calls to action.

- Help communicate the value of our products through engaging video content.

- Suggest new advertising angles and creative opportunities based on the footage available.



 5. Content Organisation & Publishing Support



- Organise raw footage, project files, podcast recordings and completed content in Google Drive.

- Prepare final videos in the correct formats for each platform.

- Upload and prepare podcast episodes and associated content through Kajabi.

- Help format and prepare blog posts and articles for publishing on Kajabi and Substack.

- Maintain an organised workflow so content can be reviewed, approved and published efficiently.



 What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing short-form videos for social media and/or paid advertising.

- A portfolio showing examples of Reels, podcast clips, testimonials or video ads you've personally edited.

- Experience editing longer videos or podcasts is highly desirable.

- Strong English comprehension and the ability to draft natural-sounding written content.

- Experience repurposing podcasts, videos or long-form content into articles, blog posts or social media content.

- Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Descript or similar editing software.

- Familiarity with AI tools for video editing, transcription, content creation and repurposing.

- Experience with YouTube, Kajabi and/or Substack is an advantage.

- Strong attention to detail, organisation and time management.

- Someone proactive who can identify good content, make creative decisions and work independently.

- An interest in dogs, pet content or animal training would be a bonus.



We're not looking for someone who simply adds subtitles to videos.We want someone who can recognise good content, make creative decisions and help us turn existing footage and recordings into a range of valuable content with minimal supervision.



How the Role Will Work



We'll provide raw footage, podcast recordings, brand references, examples of content we like and information about our products and audience.



You'll be responsible for editing videos and podcast episodes, identifying content opportunities, drafting written content and preparing assets for publishing.



We'll start with a weekly workload of approximately **6–8 hours**, with the possibility of increasing hours as our content production grows.



This is an ongoing opportunity for someone who produces quality work, communicates well and can become a trusted part of our team.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Links to 3–5 examples of content you've personally edited or created. Ideally, include a short-form video, a video ad or testimonial, and a podcast clip or longer video.

2. Examples of any blog posts, articles or other written content you've created by repurposing existing material, if available.

3. The editing software, AI tools and publishing platforms you use.

4. Your weekly availability.

5. Your estimated turnaround time for a typical 30–60 second Reel.



**Applications without a video editing portfolio will not be considered.**



To confirm you've read the full job description, please start your application with the words **"OODLE CONTENT"**.

title: Virtual Administration & Bookkeeping Assistant — Xero, Shopify & Google Sheets
description:
Virtual Administration & Bookkeeping Assistant — Xero, Shopify & Google Sheets



Remote | Supporting Australian business Pope Industries



We are looking for an accurate, organised and dependable virtual assistant to help manage the everyday administration of Cut Length Metals and ALVULT, two different businesses under the one.



Cut Length Metals supplies stainless steel, brass and aluminium cut to size. and ALVULT is a developing aluminium storage product brand.



You will work directly with the owner to keep bookkeeping, stock records, pricing, customer enquiries and general administration organised.



Your responsibilities



Xero bookkeeping for all of Pope Industries



- Enter supplier bills and receipts, with supporting documents.

- Reconcile bank transactions and flag anything unclear.

- Prepare customer invoices and track outstanding payments.

- Keep records ready for review by our accountant or bookkeeper.



Google Sheets and inventory administration for Cut Length Metals



- Maintain our existing main workbook, including pricing, stock levels and stock movements.

- Export sales from Shopify and import them into the workbook.

- Verify that imported sales update correctly across the relevant tabs.

- Check for missing SKUs, duplicate entries, incorrect quantities and formula errors.

- Investigate discrepancies and report anything you cannot resolve.



Shopify pricing for Cut Length Metals



- Identify selling price changes in the main workbook.

- Update the correct Shopify products and variants using our approved pricing rules.

- Match products accurately by SKU.

- Verify that live Shopify prices match the workbook.

- Keep a record of changes. Initially, price changes require approval before going live.



Sales inbox and customer service for Cut Length Metals and ALVULT 



- Monitor and organise sales
s for both businesses.

- Reply to routine enquiries using approved product information and procedures.

- Collect the information needed to prepare accurate quotes.

- Draft quotes and follow up outstanding enquiries.

- Progress to sending standard quotes independently once trained and approved.

- Refer technical questions and unusual requests to the owner.



General administration



- Maintain customer records, files and task lists.

- Support ALVULT enquiry tracking and follow-ups in Go High Level.

- Document recurring tasks so another person can follow the process.

- Provide a brief update on completed work, outstanding tasks and decisions needed.



What we are looking for



- Practical experience with Xero bookkeeping.

- Strong Google Sheets skills, including working with formulas, lookups and multiple connected tabs.

- Experience with Shopify product administration and CSV imports or exports.

- Clear, professional written English.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Confidence checking your own work and investigating discrepancies.

- Willingness to ask questions instead of guessing.

- Reliable internet and availability for some overlap with Queensland business hours.



Go High Level experience and experience supporting an Australian business are helpful, but not essential.



You do not need metal industry knowledge. We will teach you our products and processes.



Hours and working arrangements



The role will start at 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase as the workload grows, and you can take on more tasks 



We will agree on a regular schedule with some overlap during Queensland business hours. During the first month, you will track time by task so we can understand the workload and set realistic priorities.



How to apply



Use this subject line:



ADMIN — Stock, Sheets & Service



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a short introduction.

2. Your experience with Xero, Google Sheets and Shopify. Explain what you personally did in each system.

3. An example of a spreadsheet or bookkeeping error you found and how you resolved it. Do not share confidential client information.

4. Your proposed checks after importing Shopify sales into a workbook that updates stock across several tabs.

5. Your proposed checks before and after updating Shopify prices from a spreadsheet.

6. Your availability, earliest start date and expected hourly rate in USD.



Please also answer this scenario:



A sales import shows 25 units sold, but the stock tab has only reduced by 20 units. What would you check, and what would you report to the owner?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical trial using sample data. This will assess spreadsheet accuracy, Shopify administration and written customer communication.

title: Inside Sales Representative – Phone & Video Sales to US Businesses (Night Shift, Warm Leads)
description:

We're a small US software company selling a subscription product to service businesses across the United States. We're growing and hiring one person to own our inbound sales seat long term.

Schedule (please read carefully)



Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Pacific Time (PT), Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week

In Philippine Time (PHT): 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM until November 1. From November 2, after US daylight saving time ends, it becomes 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM.

This is a permanent night shift in the Philippines. Please apply only if you can work these hours every weekday, long term.



What You'll Do



Call and
 business owners who replied to our campaigns, within one hour of their reply

Qualify them using our written criteria

Run demos by phone and video using our proven call flow

Close entry-plan customers on the call and send the payment link while they're still on the line

Hand bigger deals to our senior closer with a short written summary

Follow up with prospects who go quiet, using our templates

Log every call and deal in our CRM the same day, and send a short Friday numbers report



Scripts, pricing, objection handling and the full process are already written. You'll be trained on all of it.



Requirements



1+ year in phone sales with US or Australian clients: inside sales, appointment setting, telesales, or closing

Clear, easily understood spoken English. Our prospects listen on mobile phones from trucks and job sites, so they need to understand you the first time.

Comfortable asking for the sale and handling objections like "it's too expensive"

Good written English for short follow-up
s

Able to work 9 AM – 5 PM Pacific Time (12 AM – 8 AM / 1 AM – 9 AM PHT) every weekday, long term

Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet with a backup, and a computer that handles video calls



Nice to Have: closing experience, software or subscription sales, Pipedrive or another CRM, experience selling to contractors or small businesses.



Earnings



Weekly base: $225 USD, paid every week via Wise.



Bonuses (paid monthly, no cap):



$75 for every new customer you close

$10 for every qualified demo you book that takes place



What that looks like: In a typical solid month, base plus bonuses comes to around $1,450 USD. Strong closers earn more, because close bonuses have no limit.



Raises: Your performance is reviewed at 3 and 6 months. Raises are based on your close rate, response times, CRM accuracy and reliability on shift. Your base pay will never be reduced.



Career growth: Top performers are promoted to Senior Sales Rep, and then to Sales Lead, where you train and manage new reps as the team grows. Each promotion brings a higher base and bigger bonuses.



Bonuses are paid once the customer's payment is collected. If a customer cancels for a refund within their first 30 days, that close isn't counted.

1. Record a Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes. Camera on, one take, no edits, no AI voice tools. Use your call headset.

 in your own words for Mike, owner of Desert Ridge Roofing. He replied to our
 asking about price but didn't answer your call. Mention that plans start at $599 a month, give the callback number (520)
, and give him one reason to call back.

Part C (about 45 sec), sales task: Mike calls back and says, "That's too expensive, and I'm on a roof. Just text me the info." Show us exactly what you'd say to book a 15-minute demo.

What have you sold, for which companies, and for how long?

What were your monthly numbers (calls, appointments, or closes)?

Can you reliably work 9 AM – 5 PM Pacific Time (12 AM – 8 AM PHT, then 1 AM – 9 AM PHT after November 1) every weekday? How will you sustain the night shift?



3. Start your application with the word "Pacific."

description:
WE ARE EXPANDING AGAIN!

**Project Accountant | Affordable Housing Development**



Make a direct impact where it counts. We build affordable housing developments that transform communities—and we need a sharp, persistent Project Accountant to keep our projects fully funded, compliant, and moving fast.



Forget red tape and invisible busywork. In this role, you sit right alongside decision-makers. title: Healthcare Content & Social Media Coordinator
description:
Role purpose

Create clear, engaging content that helps people understand Brain Aid Clinics and its services. The role focuses on video creation and editing, social media publishing, digital design, the
 newsletter, and editing blogs into content suitable for patients and referrers.

You will own the content production and publishing process, keep work moving through approval, and prepare the weekly KPI pack, including the patient tracker, for distribution by 3pm AEST each Monday.



Key responsibilities

Video creation and editing

Plan and coordinate video recording with Dr Grace and the clinical team.

Edit raw footage into polished videos for social media and other marketing channels.

Turn longer recordings into short clips, reels and educational content, using BAC's record-once Content Engine workflow (Descript).

Add accurate captions, clear titles, appropriate graphics and calls to action.

Maintain an organised library of footage, completed videos and reusable assets.



Digital design

Create social graphics, carousels, video thumbnails and blog images using BAC's brand templates.

Maintain and update BAC's digital brand templates so content stays consistent.

Brief and coordinate external designers for print and more complex design work.



Social media management

Maintain the content calendar and coordinate production, approval and publishing.

Write captions and adapt content for each platform.

Schedule and publish approved posts consistently.

Classify each piece of content by channel (public, post-enquiry or health-professional only) in line with BAC's Content Engine SOP.

Moderate comments and messages daily, respond using approved guidance, and refer clinical questions or patient enquiries to the Convert team.

Escalate immediately any comment or message suggesting a risk of harm, following BAC's risk escalation procedure.

Identify useful topics and formats based on audience questions and content performance.



Blog editing,
 newsletter and content repurposing

Edit supplied drafts, transcripts and clinician notes into clear, readable blog articles.

Improve structure, grammar, tone and basic search optimisation while preserving clinical meaning.

Repurpose approved blogs into social posts, video scripts, short clips and newsletter content.

Prepare and send the regular
 newsletter in GoHighLevel, drawing on approved blogs and videos.

Manage subscriber lists and sign-up forms, and track opens, clicks and subscriber growth.

Check that links, formatting and calls to action work before publication.

Flag clinical claims or factual gaps for review.



Weekly KPI reporting

Prepare and distribute the weekly KPI pack by 3pm AEST each Monday, covering the previous Monday to Sunday.

The pack covers BAC KPI results, digital marketing and ads (compiled with Puzzle Media's weekly report), Google Ads, social media performance, and the patient enquiry report.

Keep the patient tracker current each week, including enquiry status, psychiatrist appointment dates and treatment start dates.

Report on content published, reach, video views and watch time, engagement, audience growth, website traffic, newsletter performance and attributable enquiries where data is available.

Compare results with agreed targets and the previous week.

Summarise what worked, what underperformed and the actions proposed for the coming week.

Check figures for accuracy and clearly identify missing data or attribution limitations.



Content quality and approvals

Follow BAC's brand, privacy, patient consent and healthcare advertising requirements.

Apply AHPRA and TGA advertising rules: no testimonials, outcome guarantees or before-and-after content, and no references to TGA or ARTG status in public material.

Obtain clinical approval before publishing content that discusses conditions, treatments or clinical outcomes.

Use approved wording and escalate uncertain claims.

Handle patient information confidentially and only within the systems BAC provides.

Manage deadlines proactively and flag delays early.



Skills and experience

Demonstrated experience creating and editing short-form video.

Strong social media copywriting and blog editing skills.

Confidence using video editing, design, scheduling and analytics tools, for example Descript, Canva, Meta Business Suite, GoHighLevel, Notion and GA4.

Experience with
 marketing platforms and basic spreadsheet reporting.

Ability to turn technical information into accessible content without overstating claims.

Strong organisation, attention to detail and reliable follow-through.

Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry is preferred.

Ability to work independently and coordinate efficiently with a busy clinical team.



What success looks like

Approved content is published consistently against the agreed calendar.

Each recording produces a useful range of finished content.

Videos and written content are clear, accurate and consistent with BAC's voice.

The weekly KPI pack reaches the agreed recipients by 3pm each Monday, and the patient tracker is current.

The newsletter goes out on schedule and the subscriber list grows.

Performance insights lead to practical improvements in content and enquiry generation.

Routine production and publishing move forward without repeated reminders from Dr Grace.

Provisional targets will be agreed for the first 90 days, for example posts per week, clips per recording and newsletter sends per month, and reviewed as the role settles.



Application requirement

Please provide examples of short-form videos you have edited, social media accounts you have managed, and a blog or article you have written or edited. If you have them, please also include an
 campaign and a report or dashboard you have prepared. Include a brief explanation of your contribution to each example.

title: Virtual Assistant - YouTube Channel Management & Operations
description:
Job Description: Virtual Assistant - YouTube Channel Management & Operations



Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Virtual Assistant with specialised expertise in YouTube channel creation, management, and growth. This role combines traditional administrative support with advanced digital marketing and content management responsibilities. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in launching and scaling our Scaling.Club YouTube channel whilst managing associated revenue streams through Patreon and client services.



This position requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands the YouTube ecosystem deeply, and can work independently to drive channel growth and community engagement. You'll be responsible for the complete YouTube workflow from content planning to community management, alongside traditional VA duties including invoicing and account management.



You will be reporting directly to Grace Ng.



Key Responsibilities

1. YouTube Channel Management & Growth



Channel Setup & Optimisation: Configure channel branding, SEO optimisation, playlists, and channel layout for maximum discoverability

Content Strategy & Planning: Develop and maintain content calendars, research trending topics in business/scaling niche, and coordinate content production schedules

Video Production Support: Edit faceless videos using professional tools, create thumbnails and branded graphics, manage video uploads and scheduling

SEO & Analytics: Optimise video titles, descriptions, and tags for search performance; monitor analytics and provide weekly performance reports with actionable insights

Community Management: Respond to comments within 2-hour SLA, moderate discussions, engage with subscribers, and foster community growth

Growth Strategy Implementation: Execute subscriber growth campaigns, collaborate with other channels, and implement proven growth tactics



2. Patreon Management & Monetisation



Platform Setup: Configure Patreon tiers, rewards, and payment processing

Content Distribution: Manage exclusive content delivery to Patreon subscribers, coordinate member-only perks and early access content

Subscriber Relations: Handle Patreon member communications, process tier changes, and manage subscriber onboarding

Revenue Tracking: Monitor Patreon revenue, prepare monthly reports, and identify opportunities for tier optimization



3. Account Management & Client Relations



Client Onboarding: Manage new member sign-ups for Basecamp and Peak Services programs

Communication Management: Handle client inquiries, coordinate consultation bookings, and maintain professional correspondence

Relationship Maintenance: Regular check-ins with existing clients, manage renewal processes, and identify upselling opportunities

Database Management: Maintain accurate client records, track engagement levels, and update CRM systems



4. Invoicing & Financial Administration



Invoice Generation: Create and send invoices for Peak Services, Basecamp memberships, and consultation fees using established templates and pricing structures

Payment Tracking: Monitor payment statuses, send professional follow-ups on overdue accounts, and maintain accurate financial records

Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly revenue reports, track payment trends, and coordinate with accounting systems

Process Improvement: Streamline invoicing workflows and implement automated payment reminders



5. General Administrative Support



Document Creation: Develop YouTube-specific materials including video scripts, community guidelines, and promotional content

Project Coordination: Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, coordinate with external contractors (graphic designers, video editors)

Systems Management: Maintain organised digital filing systems, update internal trackers, and ensure data accuracy across platforms



Requirements

Essential Qualifications



YouTube Expertise: Minimum 2 years hands-on experience managing YouTube channels with demonstrated growth results (subscriber and view metrics required)

Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in YouTube Studio, video editing software (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent), thumbnail creation tools (Photoshop, Canva Pro)

Analytics & SEO: Proven experience with YouTube Analytics, TubeBuddy/VidIQ, keyword research, and growth optimization strategies

Administrative Experience: Prior experience as a virtual assistant or executive assistant with demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients/projects

Communication Skills: Exceptional written English, professional phone manner, and experience managing online communities



Preferred Qualifications



Patreon Experience: Previous experience setting up and managing Patreon accounts or similar subscription platforms

Business Content Knowledge: Familiarity with business scaling, entrepreneurship, or professional development content

Social Media Management: Experience managing multiple social platforms and cross-platform content distribution

CRM Systems: Experience with customer relationship management tools and automated marketing systems

Financial Software: Familiarity with invoicing platforms (QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks) and payment processing systems



Key Competencies



Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand business goals and translate them into actionable YouTube growth strategies

Analytical Mindset: Comfort with data analysis, performance metrics, and making data-driven recommendations

Creative Problem-Solving: Resourcefulness in overcoming technical challenges and finding innovative solutions

Time Management: Exceptional ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines, and manage competing demands

Professional Discretion: Handle confidential client information and business strategies with absolute discretion

Adaptability: Comfortable with evolving responsibilities as the channel and business grow



Technical Requirements



Reliable Internet: High-speed internet connection suitable for video uploading and live streaming support

Professional Setup: Dedicated workspace, professional communication tools, and backup systems

Software Access: Must have or be willing to invest in professional video editing and design software subscriptions

Time Zone Flexibility: Ability to work across multiple time zones and respond to urgent requests outside standard hours



Performance Metrics



YouTube channel subscriber growth (target: 25% monthly increase)

Video engagement rates (target: >5% average)

Community response time (target: 90% monthly)



What We Offer



Competitive compensation based on experience and results

Performance bonuses tied to channel growth milestones

Professional development opportunities in digital marketing

Flexible working arrangements

Opportunity to grow with an expanding business

Access to industry networks and learning resources



This role is perfect for a detail-oriented professional who is passionate about YouTube, understands the creator economy, and wants to play a key role in building a successful business education channel from the ground up.

title: People Operations Administrator | US Hours
description:
We are seeking an experienced People Operations Administrator to support the HR operations of a US-based company with approximately 150 employees.



This is a fully remote, full-time contractor role requiring availability during standard US business hours. You will manage day-to-day People Operations workflows, serve as the primary administrator for Rippling, and provide responsive, confidential support to employees and HR leadership.



Key Responsibilities

- Own the central HR inbox, respond to or route inquiries, and meet a 24-business-hour service target.

- Process employment verification requests and state unemployment claims.

- Coordinate wage garnishments, child support orders, and tax levies with payroll.

- Administer Rippling across HRIS, benefits, payroll, app management, and time and attendance.

- Maintain accurate employee records, reporting lines, job and compensation changes, and status updates.

- Build and improve Rippling workflows, task lists, and automated processes.

- Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports on headcount, turnover, leave, and training completion.

- Coordinate onboarding, including welcome communications, equipment tracking, document collection, I-9 compliance, and system access.

- Coordinate offboarding, final-pay requirements, access removal, exit surveys, and separation records.

- Support employee questions about policies, pay schedules, time off, and benefits.

- Administer benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, carrier integrations, and Open Enrollment activities.

- Manage leave requests, including FMLA, state-paid leave, parental leave, disability, and ADA accommodations.

- Monitor multi-state labor law changes, digital labor law postings, personnel records, and retention requirements.

- Administer mandatory compliance training and follow up to support timely completion.

- Support employee relations matters and workplace investigations through intake, documentation, and reporting.

- Provide operational coverage for the US HR team during planned or unplanned absences.



Required Qualifications

- 3–5+ years of People Operations or HR Generalist experience supporting a US-based workforce.

- Experience supporting a company with approximately 100–300 employees.

- Hands-on administrative experience with Rippling, including workflows, leave policies, benefits, and document management.

- Strong knowledge of multi-state US employment compliance, including FMLA, state-paid leave, wage garnishments, unemployment claims, and employment verifications.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive matters.

- Ability to work independently and provide reliable operational support across US time zones.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a remote environment.



Work Setup

- Fully remote, offshore contractor role.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- Must be available during standard US business hours (EST/PST).

- Must have a reliable computer and stable internet connection.



Application Instructions

Please submit:

- Updated resume or CV.

- Expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

- Rippling experience, including the specific modules or workflows you have administered.

- Earliest available start date.



At the top of your application, please answer:

- How many years of People Operations or HR Generalist experience do you have supporting US employees?

- What size US workforce have you supported?

- Which Rippling modules and workflows have you administered directly?

- Have you handled multi-state leave administration, unemployment claims, wage garnishments, or employment verifications? Please briefly describe your experience.

- Have you supported Open Enrollment, benefits administration, or carrier integrations?

- Are you available to work standard US business hours (EST/PST)?

- What is your expected non negotiable monthly compensation in Philippine pesos?

- When can you start?



Subject Line:

POA – YOUR FULL NAME



Example:

POA – JUAN DELA CRUZ



Only applicants who meet the required qualifications will be contacted.

title: B2B Inside Sales Specialist – US Market | Cold Calling | Remote
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 4+ years in B2B Sales / Inside Sales / Business Development

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Equipment: Own laptop/desktop and reliable high-speed internet required



About the Company



We are a fast-growing US-focused company specializing in premium architectural hardware and custom-designed architectural products, including railings, Lucite/Acrylic products, iron door handles, and other architectural solutions.



We sell to customers and businesses in the US market and are looking for an experienced B2B Inside Sales Specialist who can help us build and grow our outbound sales pipeline.



This is a hands-on hunter sales role. We are looking for someone who enjoys finding new prospects, making cold calls, sending outbound emails, connecting with decision-makers, following up consistently, and closing B2B deals.



If you are someone who is comfortable spending a significant part of your day on the phone and actively generating new business, this role may be a strong fit.

Research and identify potential B2B customers in the US market.

Build targeted prospect lists using online research, LinkedIn, company websites, directories, and other sources.

Identify decision-makers and key contacts within target companies.

Cold calls

Cold emails

LinkedIn outreach

Follow-up calls and messages

Generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.

You will primarily prospect and sell to businesses such as:



Architects

Interior Designers

General Contractors

Builders

Developers

Construction Companies

Procurement Teams

Hospitality Companies

Other B2B customers involved in construction, architecture, renovation, and commercial projects

Qualify leads and understand customer requirements.

Present our architectural hardware and customized product solutions.

Prepare and discuss quotations and proposals.

Explain product specifications, pricing, availability, and delivery timelines.

Handle customer questions and objections.

Negotiate pricing and commercial terms.

Follow up with prospects until a decision is reached.

Close new B2B accounts and generate revenue.

Coordinate with internal teams after the sale to ensure smooth order execution.

Maintain accurate customer and prospect information in our CRM/ERP system.

Record calls, emails, meetings, opportunities, and follow-ups.

Keep the sales pipeline updated at all times.

Track lead generation and conversion activity.

Provide regular sales and pipeline reports.

Review results and continuously improve prospecting strategies.

Strong follow-up discipline.

title: Part-Time E-commerce Assistant
description:
Job Title: Part-Time E-commerce Assistant



Platforms: Shopify and TikTok Shop



Job Overview



Chicago Dollz Experience is looking for a proactive, organised, and detail-oriented Part-Time E-commerce Assistant to manage, monitor, and maintain our Shopify store and TikTok Shop.



The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure both platforms remain active, accurate, organised, visually appealing, and up to date. This includes maintaining product listings and inventory, monitoring orders, updating storefront designs, implementing seasonal promotions, and improving the overall shopping experience.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms, a strong eye for design, and the ability to manage daily store operations while keeping the storefront aligned with the Chicago Dollz Experience brand.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail, stays on top of daily tasks, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Shopify Store Management

- Regularly monitor and maintain the Shopify store.

- Keep product listings, descriptions, images, prices, and variants accurate and up to date.

- Update product availability and inventory information.

- Organise collections, categories, product pages, and store information.

- Check for outdated information, missing product details, broken links, and other store issues.

- Ensure the storefront remains functional, professional, and updated.

- Maintain consistency across product information and store presentation.



2. TikTok Shop Management

- Monitor and maintain the TikTok Shop regularly.

- Keep product listings, images, descriptions, pricing, and stock information updated.

- Check product statuses and ensure products are properly listed and available for sale.

- Monitor orders, fulfilment statuses, shipping updates, and customer-related issues.

- Check for product listing violations, warnings, or platform notifications and report issues promptly.

- Update product images, collections, and promotional features where TikTok Shop allows.

- Ensure the shop follows applicable TikTok Shop policies and requirements.



3. Seasonal Storefront Design and Shopping Experience

- Create and maintain an attractive, professional storefront that reflects the Chicago Dollz Experience brand.

- Plan and implement seasonal updates, including homepage banners, promotional graphics, featured products, and collections.

- Maintain a seasonal calendar covering fall, Black Friday, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, summer, and other approved promotions.

- Keep the core store design consistent while refreshing selected visuals and promotions. A complete redesign is not required for every holiday.

- Remove expired promotions and seasonal graphics promptly.

- Organise menus, collections, and product pages so customers can easily find products and complete purchases.

- Check that banners, buttons, menus, and product links lead to the correct destinations.

- Review the store on mobile and desktop to identify confusing layouts, poor-quality images, and shopping obstacles.

- Research established e-commerce stores for inspiration and recommend improvements suited to our brand.

- Update TikTok Shop product images, collections, and promotional features where the platform allows.

- Handle routine design and layout updates within approved guidelines, and flag technical changes that require specialist support.



4. Order and Inventory Monitoring

- Check incoming orders and monitor their status.

- Track stock availability and identify low-stock or out-of-stock products.

- Monitor order fulfilment and shipping updates.

- Identify discrepancies between Shopify and TikTok Shop inventory.

- Escalate delayed orders, inventory issues, and fulfilment concerns when necessary.

- Monitor cancelled orders and investigate discrepancies between Shopify and TikTok Shop records.

- Report order issues that require further investigation or approval.



5. Store Organisation and Maintenance

- Keep both platforms organised and consistent.

- Regularly review product information, pricing, inventory, and store settings.

- Maintain trackers and records of updates, pending tasks, seasonal campaigns, and identified issues.

- Ensure important tasks and promotional updates are completed on schedule.

- Keep product categories, collections, menus, and promotional content organised.

- Identify opportunities to improve store organisation and the customer shopping experience.



6. Monitoring and Reporting

- Conduct regular checks of both platforms during scheduled working hours.

- Monitor store notifications, sales activity, product performance, and operational issues.

- Prepare brief updates on completed tasks, pending items, and issues requiring attention.

- Report technical problems, account warnings, customer concerns, and other urgent matters.

- Proactively flag anything that needs the owner's review or approval.

- Provide recommendations for improving store presentation, product visibility, and operational efficiency.



## Qualifications and Requirements



- Hands-on experience with Shopify and/or TikTok Shop is preferred.

- Hands-on experience updating Shopify themes, homepage sections, navigation, banners, and collections.

- A strong eye for design, product presentation, and an easy-to-use shopping experience.

- Ability to create branded promotional graphics using Canva or a similar design tool.

- Ability to plan and manage seasonal promotional updates and maintain a marketing calendar.

- Ability to share examples of storefronts, seasonal campaigns, or product pages they have worked on.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to monitor multiple platforms and manage tasks consistently.

- Proactive, dependable, and willing to take initiative.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets, trackers, and online tools.

- Able to work independently and provide regular updates.

- Willingness to learn new tools, systems, and e-commerce processes.



Working Expectations



- Part-time position with mutually agreed working hours.

- Complete regular checks of Shopify and TikTok Shop during scheduled hours.

- Keep both stores accurate, organised, active, and up to date.

- Plan seasonal updates ahead of major promotional dates.

- Complete routine store updates and design changes independently within approved brand guidelines.

- Seek approval for major promotional campaigns, significant design changes, pricing changes, and other decisions outside the agreed scope.

- Communicate promptly regarding technical issues or matters requiring additional support.

- Provide a daily or scheduled summary of completed tasks, outstanding items, and store concerns.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Accuracy and consistency of product listings, pricing, and inventory.

- Timeliness of product and storefront updates.

- Consistency of store monitoring and maintenance.

- Timely implementation and removal of seasonal promotions.

- Quality and brand consistency of storefront visuals.

- Accuracy of banners, navigation, buttons, and product links.

- Timely identification and reporting of order or platform issues.

- Organisation of store records, task trackers, and seasonal calendars.

- Responsiveness, reliability, and completion of assigned tasks.



Primary Goal



To ensure that the Shopify store and TikTok Shop for Chicago Dollz Experience remain well-maintained, organised, accurate, visually appealing, and ready to serve customers through consistent monitoring, proactive daily management, and timely seasonal storefront updates.



The successful candidate will help maintain a professional and engaging shopping experience while ensuring that both platforms accurately represent the brand throughout the year.

title: Mozaik Joinery & Cabinet Drafter
description:
Note: Work Arrangement: 100% Remote – Work from Home



ABOUT COAST BAY KITCHENS & CABINETS

Coast Bay Kitchens & Cabinets (CBK) is a premium Sydney-based joinery and cabinet-making company delivering bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, laundries, and custom joinery solutions across residential and commercial projects throughout New South Wales.

Backed by in-house CNC production, a skilled on-floor team, and a commitment to design excellence, CBK is growing rapidly and building a remote production-support function to scale its drafting pipeline without compromising quality or turnaround time. 



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Mozaik Drafter to join our team remotely from the Philippines. You will work directly from client-supplied plans and specifications — interpreting architectural drawings, builder layouts, and client briefs — and produce accurate, CNC-ready cabinet and joinery drawings using Mozaik software.

This is an excellent long-term opportunity for someone who is passionate about cabinetry design, takes pride in precision, and wants to grow with a quality-focused Australian company.

Drafting & Design

● Interpret architectural floor plans, elevations, and client briefs to produce detailed cabinet and joinery shop drawings in Mozaik

● Draft kitchens, wardrobes, laundries, entertainment units, study nooks, and other custom joinery items to CBK standards

● Produce CNC-ready cut lists, component sheets, and assembly drawings for the production floor

● Apply correct material specifications, panel sizes, hardware details, and joinery techniques as required

● Manage multiple drawing sets simultaneously, maintaining accuracy across all project stages





Project Coordination

● Liaise with the CBK Director and production team via
, cloud folders, and scheduled video calls

● Receive project briefs, upload completed drawings, and track revision requests through Google Drive or Dropbox

● Proactively flag drawing conflicts, missing information, and ambiguous specifications before proceeding with the work

● Meet project deadlines and communicate clearly if timelines are at risk



Quality & Standards

● Ensure all drawings conform to CBK templates, naming conventions, and file organisation standards

● Perform thorough self-checks before submitting drawings — dimensions, clearances, hardware placements, and material codes

● Incorporate feedback from revisions promptly and accurately

● Maintain consistent drawing quality across all project types and scales



Quoting Support (as required)

● Update drawings in line with approved scope changes or variation requests



TOOLS & SYSTEMS

Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)  Communication, cut lists, schedules     Required

Google Meet / Zoom                    Team catch-ups & briefings                 Required

 (Gmail or Outlook)            Day-to-day project communication          Required

SketchUp / AutoCAD                     Interpreting reference drawings          Advantageous



ABOUT YOU — ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

To be considered for this role, you must meet ALL of the following:

● Proficiency in Mozaik cabinetry software — this is a hard requirement; applications without demonstrated Mozaik experience will not be progressed

● Minimum 2–5 years of experience in joinery or cabinet drafting in a production environment

● Solid understanding of cabinet construction methods — carcass, face frame, hinge placements, drawer configurations, shelving, and hardware

● Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, floor plans, and elevation details

● High level of accuracy and attention to detail — errors in drawings have direct production costs

ADVANTAGEOUS (NOT ESSENTIAL)
