● Experience working with Australian or New Zealand construction or joinery companies

● Basic SketchUp or AutoCAD skills for interpreting 3D or 2D reference drawings

● Exposure to quoting software or ERP systems used in joinery (e.g., Cabinet Vision, Cabmaster)



WHAT WE OFFER

● Stable, long-term remote contract with a growing Sydney joinery company

● Direct working relationship with the company Director — no bureaucracy, quick decisions

● Regular, predictable project workflow — no feast-or-famine freelance cycles

● Mozaik software licence provided and supported by CBK

● Opportunity to expand your role and responsibilities as the company grows

description:

Our content includes Amazon shoppable video reviews, long-form YouTube videos, product demonstrations, side-by-side comparison tests, unboxings, and short-form TikTok content — all designed to educate, engage, and help viewers make informed purchasing decisions.



Please apply with 5 AP if seriously considering position.

YouTube:

ABOUT SHANA WALKER'S REVIEWS

We produce authentic, helpful, and engaging content showcasing everyday Amazon products. Our goal is to create high-quality videos that demonstrate products in real-world situations, answer shoppers' questions, and help viewers d
 whether a product is right for them.

We're building for the long term, and we're looking for an experienced editor who can take ownership of post-production and help us consistently produce excellent content across multiple platforms. Your editing will play an important role in the quality and growth of our brand.

This is an editing-focused position with flexible hours, starting part-time with the potential to transition to full-time as the business grows.



________________________________________

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS — 30-DAY PAID TRAINING PERIOD

________________________________________



All new hires begin with a paid 30-day training period. This is your opportunity to learn our systems, workflows, and standards — and for us to see how you work. At the end of the 30 days, we'll make a final hiring decision based on your performance, reliability, and fit with the team. Candidates who complete training successfully move into the role.



________________________________________

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: 3D Rendering + AI Visualization Artist (Hotels and Events)
description:
ABOUT US

YKMD is a fully remote brand agency for boutique hotels, events and service brands across the U.S. and Caribbean. We create realistic, styled images of hotel rooms and event spaces so our clients can sell them before they're built or finished.



OBJECTIVE

We need a 3D Rendering + AI Visualization Artist for project-based work.



You'll build or work from 3D models of rooms and spaces, then use AI image tools to take them to a photorealistic, styled finish. Think lighting, textures, plants, fabrics, decor and atmosphere. The final image should look like a professional photo of a real, finished space.



Clients often want specific furniture, fixtures, art or branded items in their rooms. You'll place those exact objects in the scene, from product photos, links or spec sheets, so they look like they belong there.



Accuracy matters as much as looks. Logos, signage, brand names, objects and room layouts have to match the original exactly. AI loves to scramble text and swap objects. You need to catch it and fix it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build or refine 3D models of hotel rooms, lounges and event spaces

- Render each room type from multiple angles

- Use AI tools to bring renders to a photorealistic, styled finish

- Place specific client-provided objects (furniture, decor, fixtures, signage) accurately and to scale

- Keep layouts, furniture placement and branding true to the original design

- Make sure all logos, signage and text are clean and spelled correctly

- Handle up to 2 rounds of revisions per room

- Deliver high-resolution final files on deadline



WHAT YOU NEED

- Architecture, interior design or 3D visualization background

- Strong skills in SketchUp, 3ds Max, Blender or similar

- Experience with render engines like V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion or Corona

- Hands-on experience with AI image tools (Midjourney, Krea, Magnific, Photoshop Generative Fill or similar)

- Ability to model or source exact objects from product photos or links and place them in a scene to scale, matching color, material and proportions

- Photoshop skills for cleanup and fixing logos and text

- A sharp eye for lighting, materials and styling

- Hospitality or event space work is a big plus

- Reliable with deadlines and good communication



HOW THIS WORKS

This is project-based. A typical project is 3 room types, 4 angles each (12 images), with 2 rounds of revisions per room. You're paid per project. Strong performers get first pick of new projects as they come in.



HOW TO APPLY

1. A short intro about your background and the software you use

3. Which AI tools you use and how they fit into your process

4. Your rate per image or per project, and your usual turnaround time



Start your OnlineJobs.ph application with the words "Render Ready" so we know you read the full post. Applications without the completed form will not be reviewed.

title: Cleaning Company VA: Booking, Dispatch + Customer Calls (US House Cleaning Experience + American-Sounding English)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern.



PAY: $800/month to start, $1,000/month after 60 days if it's working. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time, working directly with the two owners. No middle managers.



⚠️ TWO THINGS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE. READ THESE FIRST.



1. You've already done this exact job for a US house cleaning company. You've worked as a VA, booker or dispatcher for a US maid service: recurring cleans, deep cleans, move-outs. Window cleaning, pressure washing, janitorial-only or Airbnb turnovers don't count. If you haven't worked for a US house cleaning company, please don't apply. We'll skip it, even if you're great at everything else.



2. You sound like you were born and raised in the United States. This is the one part we can't bend on. Almost everyone who applies speaks great English, so that's not what we're judging. We're listening for one thing: would a customer in Miami who calls us assume they're talking to someone from the US? If there's any accent at all, even a light one, we won't be able to pick you. No hard feelings, and it's nothing against you or your English. This job just needs someone who sounds like a native US speaker: natural American phrasing, and you get how Americans talk (small talk, how people book and complain, holidays, tipping, football season, pop culture). If people often ask whether you grew up in the States, this job is for you.



Spanish is a big plus. A lot of our clients speak Spanish, so if you can take a call in Spanish too, tell us and show us in your voice message.



ABOUT US

We're Mark and Joey, two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff, and you'd be the voice of the company. We want someone who feels like a friend on the team: chill, funny, and locks in when it counts. If you're super formal and stiff, this probably isn't for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Booking and sales (most of the job)

- Text every new lead back in under a minute, then call them. Leads come from Thumbtack, Google and our website.

- Quote from our price list (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, add-ons like inside the fridge and oven) and close the booking in our CRM.

- Handle "that's more than I expected," and follow up with everyone who didn't book.



Dispatch

- Match each booked clean with a cleaner in that area, and confirm both the day before and the morning of.

- When a cleaner cancels at 7 AM for a 9 AM job, find a replacement fast and tell the client before they notice.



Customer service

- Reschedules, add-ons and complaints. A missed spot means booking a reclean, not arguing.

- Keep every client's notes right: gate codes, parking, pets, what they care about.



MUST HAVE

- 1+ year booking or dispatching for a US house cleaning company. Name the company, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week.

- You've quoted cleans by bedrooms/bathrooms or square feet, and you know a standard from a deep from a move-out clean.

- You sound born and raised in the US, with zero accent (see #2 above). We d
 this from your voice message only.

- At your computer the whole shift, replying in under a minute. Reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet room and a good headset.



BIG PLUS

- Spanish, well enough to take a booking call

- Cleaning software: Booking Koala, ZenMaid, Launch27, Jobber, Housecall Pro, MaidCentral

- Quo/OpenPhone, Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services

- You know Miami and keep up with US pop culture



WHAT WE OFFER

- Training on our price list, scripts and tools

- A raise to $1,000/month after 60 days, and real room to grow as we grow



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it. Write like you'd text a friend; typos are fine. Skip a step and we won't read the rest.



1. Subject line: "Vassal VA – [your name] – [the US cleaning company you worked for]"

2. Your house cleaning experience in 3–4 sentences: the company, the city it served, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week, and what software you used.

3. A 60–90 second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom; make sure the link opens without a login). Talk like it's a real call: a lead asks "How much for a deep clean, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, about 1,800 sq ft?" Give a price (make one up). They say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next. If you speak Spanish, do 20 seconds of it in Spanish at the end.

4. Two quick texts, 1–2 sentences each:

   a. A client texts that the cleaner missed the baseboards and the shower glass. What do you text back?

   b. A cleaner texts at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

5. Three quick ones, one line each. No Googling. Wrong answers are fine, we just want your gut answer.

   a. Who is TJR?

   b. A client says "I'm in the 305." What does that mean?

   c. On a Sunday in October a client says "Can the cleaner come after the Dolphins game?" Roughly what time do you book it for?

6. Confirm you can work 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test call with us.

 blasts and SMS broadcasts via Resimpli / marketing tools.

title: Full-Time React / Remotion Developer for AI Video Platform
description:
We’re hiring one full-time developer to help turn a working internal AI video tool into a reliable production platform.



The tool takes scripts and voiceovers, generates and selects visuals, then renders complete long-form videos that can be 2–3 hours long. The core rendering layer uses Remotion and React and connects to several external APIs. It already works and is being used in production. We now need to make it faster, more reliable and capable of handling more visual formats.



You will be the main day-to-day builder. A separate senior developer will review architecture and important code, so you will have technical support without being micromanaged.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON



- React, TypeScript, Node.js and Remotion development

- Long-running video render jobs, queues, retries and checkpointing

- FFmpeg and other media-processing work

- API and AI-model integrations

- Cloud storage and production deployments

- Fixing bugs and reducing manual work

- Improving render speed, cost and reliability

- Building new production features from clear acceptance criteria

- Tests, documentation and clean GitHub pull requests



WHAT WE NEED



- Strong React, TypeScript and Node.js ability

- Experience with Remotion, FFmpeg or programmatic video generation is a major advantage

- Experience with APIs, asynchronous jobs and production systems

- Evidence that you have personally shipped real software

- Strong debugging skills

- Fast, clear communication and reliable daily availability

- Ability to work independently, raise blockers early and explain trade-offs

- Comfortable using AI coding tools, while still verifying and understanding everything you ship

- Able to commit 40 hours per week long term



PAY AND PROCESS



- $800–$1,000 USD per month to start, depending on ability

- Paid 8-hour practical trial using a small, clearly defined task

- Four-week initial proving period

- Performance and salary review after 60 days

- Long-term role for someone who consistently ships good work quickly



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word REMOTION so I know you read the full post.



Then answer these questions in order:



1. Link 2–3 live products, repositories or relevant projects you personally built. Explain exactly what you did on each.

2. What experience do you have with Remotion, FFmpeg or video/media pipelines?

3. Describe the hardest production bug you personally diagnosed and fixed.

4. Which AI coding tools do you use, and how do you verify the code they produce?

5. What is your exact weekly availability and time zone?

title: NOW HIRING: VIRAL CONTENT CLIPPING & SOCIAL MEDIA DISTRIBUTION SPECIALIST
description:
NOW HIRING: VIRAL CONTENT CLIPPING & SOCIAL MEDIA DISTRIBUTION SPECIALIST



Position: Social Media Virtual Assistant / Viral Content Clipping Specialist

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Long-Term Opportunity

Focus: High-Volume Content Creation, Viral Marketing, Social Media Distribution, AI-Assisted Editing & Performance Analytics



ABOUT US



We are looking for a highly motivated, creative, analytical, and results-driven Social Media Virtual Assistant to help build and operate a network of supporting social media accounts for several established entertainment, music, lifestyle, and hospitality brands based in the United States.



Our brands include:



* Laci Kay Somers – Influencer, entertainer, and lifestyle personality.

* Velvet Cash – Recording artist, music producer, and entertainer.

* Saltmine Studio Oasis – Legendary recording studio, entertainment venue, and creative production facility.

* Diamond Don’s – Restaurant, bar, and live entertainment destination.





We produce a significant amount of professional video and photo content, and we already have extensive libraries of content published online.



We are looking for someone who can take this existing content, creatively repurpose it, and distribute it across multiple social media platforms through a network of supporting fan, entertainment, and community accounts.



Think of this position as operating a high-volume viral content clipping agency dedicated to our brands.



This is not a traditional social media management position. We are looking for someone who understands how to maximize content distribution, experiment with viral marketing strategies, analyze results, and continuously improve performance.



⸻



OUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Our goal is to create a high-volume content distribution system that continuously tests different creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences.



We believe a single piece of content can be transformed into dozens of different variations by changing:



* The opening hook

* On-screen text

* Video length

* Editing style

* Captions

* Music and sound effects

* Pacing

* Storytelling angle

* Thumbnail

* Target audience

* Platform-specific formatting



We want someone who can consistently experiment with these variables, analyze the results, and identify winning content.



OUR PHILOSOPHY: CREATE. POST. ANALYZE. IMPROVE. REPEAT.



The ultimate goal is to discover high-performing content through our supporting accounts and deliver those winning clips to our team for publication and potential paid advertising on our official brand accounts.



⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CREATE & MANAGE A NETWORK OF SUPPORTING SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS



You will be responsible for building and managing a network of secondary social media accounts that support our brands.



These accounts may include:



* TikTok accounts

* Instagram pages

*
 pages

* YouTube channels

* Entertainment-focused pages

* Music discovery pages

* Fan and community pages

* Behind-the-scenes content channels



Your responsibilities will include:



* Creating new supporting social media accounts.

* Developing unique content strategies for different accounts.

* Maintaining consistent posting schedules.

* Optimizing profiles, descriptions, and branding.

* Growing audiences organically.

* Researching relevant communities and engagement opportunities.

* Managing legitimate fan communities and engagement groups.

* Experimenting with different content categories and presentation styles.

* Monitoring account growth and performance.



IMPORTANT: You will NOT have access to or manage our official brand accounts.



Our team will continue managing all official accounts. Your responsibility is to operate supporting accounts that expand our reach and introduce our content to new audiences.



Supporting pages should be clearly identified as fan, community, or promotional accounts where appropriate.



⸻



2. INDEPENDENT CONTENT SOURCING & RESEARCH



One of the most important aspects of this position is the ability to work independently and proactively discover content opportunities.



We will provide two primary sources of content.



SOURCE #1: EXISTING PUBLIC SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT



Our brands already have extensive libraries of videos, photos, interviews, performances, behind-the-scenes footage, and other content published across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and other platforms.



We expect you to independently:



* Research and regularly review our existing social media pages.

* Identify older videos and posts with viral potential.

* Download and organize our existing content using appropriate tools and authorized methods.

* Find interesting moments, funny interactions, performances, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage.

* Turn existing posts into fresh short-form videos.

* Discover content opportunities without waiting for instructions.

* Continuously revisit our existing content libraries to identify new creative angles.

* Monitor newly published content from our official pages for repurposing opportunities.



We do not want someone who waits for us to send them videos every day.



We want someone who takes initiative, researches our brands, identifies opportunities, and independently produces content.



SOURCE #2: PRIVATE GOOGLE DRIVE CONTENT LIBRARY



In addition to our publicly available content, we will provide access to a shared Google Drive folder containing additional videos, photos, and other media.



You will be expected to:



* Regularly review the Google Drive content library.

* Identify interesting footage that has not yet been published.

* Find opportunities to create multiple clips from longer videos.

* Combine available footage into engaging short-form content.

* Organize and track which materials have already been used.

* Develop new content ideas based on available footage.

* Maintain an organized archive of source materials and finished clips.



Our goal is to provide access to a large content library while giving you the creative freedom to independently identify and execute opportunities.



⸻



3. HIGH-VOLUME CONTENT CREATION & DISTRIBUTION



Your primary responsibility will be maximizing the amount of quality content distributed across our supporting social media accounts.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating a high volume of short-form video clips.

* Repurposing existing content into multiple variations.

* Publishing content consistently across supporting accounts.

* Editing videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Creating multiple versions of successful clips.

* Repurposing older content into fresh, engaging posts.

* Identifying opportunities to create additional content from existing footage.

* Maintaining an organized publishing schedule.

* Adapting content for different platforms and audiences.



We want someone who can produce a high volume of content without sacrificing creativity or quality.



The objective is to maximize meaningful content experiments and distribution opportunities, not simply upload identical videos repeatedly.



⸻



4. AI-POWERED VIRAL HOOKS & CONTENT EXPERIMENTATION



We strongly encourage the use of ChatGPT and other AI tools to brainstorm creative ways to make our content more engaging.



We are especially interested in attention-grabbing, entertainment-news-style content inspired by platforms such as TMZ.



Examples of creative approaches include:



* Dramatic, curiosity-driven headlines.

* Entertainment news-style text overlays.

* Funny or unexpected observations.

* Debate-provoking questions.

* Behind-the-scenes revelations.

* Celebrity and entertainment-focused hooks.

* Emotional storytelling.

* Unexpected moments and surprising interactions.

* Trending meme formats.

* Viral storytelling techniques.



MULTIPLE VARIATIONS OF THE SAME VIDEO



We want you to regularly experiment with creating 5–10 meaningfully different versions of the same original video when appropriate.



For example, one original video could become:



1. A 10-second attention-grabbing highlight.

2. A 30-second storytelling clip.

3. A dramatic edit with an emotional hook.

4. A funny version with humorous captions.

5. A behind-the-scenes version.

6. A version with curiosity-driven text overlays.

7. A reaction-style video.

8. A version with a completely different opening three seconds.

9. A version with a trending audio format.

10. A different edit targeting another audience.



Each variation should be treated as an opportunity to learn what attracts attention and generates engagement.



EXAMPLE CHATGPT PROMPT



“Analyze this video and generate 20 attention-grabbing, TMZ-style viral headlines that could be used as text overlays for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Make them entertaining, dramatic, curiosity-driven, and designed to stop viewers from scrolling. Keep them short, punchy, and compelling while remaining truthful to the actual footage. Then identify the 10 strongest hooks for testing.”



Your responsibilities will include:



* Finding interesting content from our existing pages or Google Drive.

* Identifying the strongest moments to clip.

* Using ChatGPT to brainstorm multiple viral hooks.

* Creating 5–10 creative variations when appropriate.

* Testing those variations across relevant supporting accounts.

* Tracking which hooks generate the strongest performance.

* Analyzing why certain versions outperform others.

* Creating additional variations based on winning approaches.

* Reporting successful strategies to our team.

* Delivering the strongest-performing clips for potential use on our official brand accounts.



We want you to think like a viral content strategist, not simply a video editor.



⸻



5. VIRAL CONTENT TESTING & EXPERIMENTATION



We want to continuously test different versions of content to determine what performs best.



Each piece of content should be treated as an experiment.



We want to understand:



* Which opening hooks generate the most views?

* Which text overlays capture attention?

* Which video lengths perform best?

* Which editing styles generate the most engagement?

* Which types of content generate the most shares?

* Which captions encourage comments?

* Which platforms perform best for different content categories?

* Which content deserves additional variations?

* Which content consistently underperforms?



We want constant experimentation with new creative ideas and strategies.



The objective is not simply to produce content but to continuously improve our understanding of what makes content successful.



⸻



6. DAILY, WEEKLY & MONTHLY PERFORMANCE REPORTING



THIS IS ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE POSITION.



We expect detailed, organized performance reporting so we can understand what content is working, what is not working, and how to improve.



DAILY REPORTS



At the end of each workday, provide:



* Number of clips created.

* Number of posts published.

* Accounts and platforms used.

* Total views generated.

* Top-performing clips of the day.

* Lowest-performing clips of the day.

* Which hooks, captions, or editing styles performed best.

* Which approaches performed poorly.

* Recommendations for the following day’s content strategy.



WEEKLY REPORTS



Every week, provide:



* Total content created and distributed.

* Total views and engagement across all accounts.

* Top 10 best-performing posts.

* Bottom 10 lowest-performing posts.

* Comparison of performance across platforms.

* Identification of successful content categories.

* Identification of unsuccessful content categories.

* Analysis of winning hooks, captions, video lengths, and editing styles.

* Recommendations for increasing content performance.

* A strategy for the following week based on actual results.



MONTHLY REPORTS



Every month, provide a comprehensive performance summary including:



* Total clips produced.

* Total posts published.

* Total views generated.

* Follower growth across supporting accounts.

* Total engagement.

* Best-performing content of the month.

* Worst-performing content of the month.

* Trends in audience behavior.

* Successful content experiments.

* Unsuccessful content experiments.

* Opportunities for scaling successful strategies.

* Recommendations for improving the overall content distribution system.



CONTENT PERFORMANCE TRACKING



We expect you to maintain an organized spreadsheet or dashboard tracking individual content experiments.



Each published clip should be tracked using metrics such as:



* Original source video

* Brand

* Platform

* Supporting account

* Hook or creative variation

* Posting date

* Views

* Likes

* Comments

* Shares

* Engagement rate

* Performance after 24 hours

* Performance after 72 hours

* Performance after seven days



Content should be categorized as:



WINNER: Strong performance with opportunities for further testing and distribution.



RETEST: Promising content that may perform better with adjustments.



UNDERPERFORMER: Content that consistently fails to generate meaningful engagement.



Performance should be evaluated relative to the account’s typical results, not simply by total views.



We want reporting that provides actionable insights, not simply numbers.



⸻



7. DOUBLE DOWN ON WHAT WORKS



A major part of this role is identifying successful content and expanding on it.



When a particular clip, hook, format, or editing style performs well, we want to:



1. Analyze why it performed well.

2. Identify which elements contributed to its success.

3. Create additional variations using those successful elements.

4. Test those variations across relevant platforms.

5. Compare results and identify improvements.

6. Continue refining the strategy based on performance.



Likewise, when content consistently performs poorly, we want to understand why and adjust our approach.



The goal is to continuously increase our success rate by learning from every piece of content published.



We expect you to use ChatGPT and other tools to brainstorm ways to improve successful content and develop new creative strategies.



⸻



8. IDENTIFY WINNING CONTENT FOR OUR OFFICIAL BRANDS



THIS IS THE ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE OF THE ENTIRE OPERATION.



Our supporting social media accounts will function as a creative testing and content discovery network.



When a particular clip demonstrates exceptional performance, your responsibility will be to:



* Identify the winning content.

* Explain why it performed well.

* Provide performance metrics supporting your recommendation.

* Deliver the finished video to our team.

* Provide the best-performing caption, hook, and title.

* Recommend whether the content should be published on our official accounts.

* Identify clips that may be suitable for paid advertising.

* Suggest additional variations that could be tested.



Our team will continue managing all official brand accounts.



You will NOT have access to our official social media accounts.



Your responsibility is to identify and deliver high-performing content that we can publish and potentially promote through advertising.



⸻



9. SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT



In addition to creating and distributing content, you will help grow the supporting social media network.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching relevant communities and audiences.

* Engaging authentically with followers.

* Responding to comments and encouraging discussions.

* Identifying trending topics and content opportunities.

* Researching successful clipping agencies and entertainment accounts.

* Developing strategies to increase organic reach.

* Building legitimate fan communities and engagement groups.

* Identifying opportunities for collaboration with relevant creators.

* Monitoring account growth and audience behavior.



We want creative, sustainable audience growth strategies that comply with platform policies.



⸻



10. CONTENT ORGANIZATION & WORKFLOW MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for maintaining an organized and efficient content production system.



Responsibilities include:



* Organizing original videos and photos.

* Maintaining folders of edited clips.

* Tracking which clips have already been published.

* Organizing different versions of the same content.

* Maintaining a publishing calendar.

* Tracking performance across accounts.

* Maintaining a library of successful hooks and captions.

* Documenting successful editing styles and content strategies.

* Providing our team with access to finished clips and performance reports.



We want a system that allows us to easily identify successful content and understand what is working.



⸻



IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:



* Has experience with short-form video editing and social media clipping.

* Understands viral content strategies.

* Is comfortable producing and publishing content at high volume.

* Understands TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Has experience with CapCut, Canva, or similar software.

* Is proficient with ChatGPT and other AI tools.

* Understands social media analytics.

* Can identify patterns in successful content.

* Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Can work independently.

* Is creative, proactive, and constantly experimenting.

* Has excellent written English skills.

* Is motivated by measurable results.

* Can independently source content without waiting for instructions.

* Understands how to write attention-grabbing hooks and captions.



BONUS EXPERIENCE



* Previous work for a clipping agency.

* Experience managing viral fan pages.

* Experience growing TikTok or YouTube Shorts channels.

* Experience with influencer marketing.

* Experience using AI-assisted video editing tools.

* Knowledge of entertainment, music, nightlife, and influencer culture.

* Experience managing multiple supporting social media accounts.

* Experience building performance dashboards and reporting systems.



⸻



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Performance will be evaluated based on:



1. Volume of quality content produced.

2. Consistency of content distribution.

3. Total views and engagement generated.

4. Improvement in content performance over time.

5. Quality and usefulness of daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

6. Ability to identify successful creative strategies.

7. Ability to use AI to improve productivity and creativity.

8. Number of high-performing clips delivered to our official brands.

9. Overall growth of the supporting social media network.

10. Ability to independently identify and execute content opportunities.



We value productivity, creativity, initiative, and measurable results.



⸻



PROACTIVE WORK ETHIC



We value individuals who:



* Take initiative without constant supervision.

* Find their own content opportunities.

* Use AI tools creatively and efficiently.

* Consistently experiment with new approaches.

* Understand how to capture attention within the first few seconds.

* Analyze results and make informed decisions.

* Continuously look for ways to improve performance.

* Can maintain a high volume of meaningful content experiments.

* Are excited about discovering the next viral video.



Our ideal candidate should never be sitting around waiting for content or instructions. There should always be opportunities to discover, create, test, analyze, and improve.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous social media management or clipping experience.

3. Examples of short-form videos you have edited.

4. Examples of accounts you have managed or grown.

5. Your experience with ChatGPT and AI-assisted content creation.

6. Your experience tracking and analyzing social media performance.

7. How many short-form clips you can realistically produce per day.

8. Your desired monthly salary in USD.

9. Your availability and preferred working hours.



APPLICATION CHALLENGE



Imagine we provide you with a 60-second video.



Explain how you would:



1. Create 10 different versions using different hooks, captions, and editing styles.

2. Distribute those versions across multiple supporting social media accounts.

3. Track and compare their performance.

4. Identify which versions have the greatest viral potential.

5. Use ChatGPT to develop additional creative variations.

6. Expand on the winning content.

7. Present your findings in a daily performance report.

8. Deliver the best-performing version to our team for potential publication and paid advertising.



We are looking for someone who understands that successful viral marketing requires creativity, volume, experimentation, analytics, and continuous improvement.



OUR GOAL IS SIMPLE:



PRODUCE MORE CONTENT. TEST MORE IDEAS. ANALYZE THE RESULTS. SCALE THE WINNERS. GROW OUR BRANDS.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity to help build a powerful, data-driven content distribution operation supporting multiple established entertainment brands.

- BookingKoala admin: new bookings, reschedules, cleaner assignments

 - Customer inbox: inquiries, reschedule requests, follow-ups (templates provided, good judgment expected)

>

title: Senior Product and Graphic Designer
description:
We're looking for a senior designer to own both our product experience and our brand. You'll design the software our customers use every day and the marketing that brings them in. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between UX and graphic design without losing quality.

What you'll do

Product design (about 60%)

• Design screens, user flows and interactions for a web-based SaaS platform, from rough wireframes to dev-ready Figma files.

• Build and maintain a component library and design system the engineering team can build from directly.

• Simplify complex workflows and data dashboards so non-technical users understand them at a glance.

• Design onboarding and setup flows that get new customers live with minimal support.

• Prepare clean handoffs with specs, states and edge cases, and review builds before release.

• Run simple usability tests and turn feedback into design improvements.

Brand and graphic design (about 40%)

• Apply and extend our brand guidelines: logo use, colour, typography, iconography and illustration.

• Design sales collateral, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies and proposal templates.

• Create marketing assets: social media ads, video thumbnails and ad frames,
 templates and banners.

• Design landing pages and website updates focused on conversion.

• Produce event and trade-show materials when needed.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional design experience.

• A portfolio showing both shipped SaaS product UI and brand or marketing design.

• Expert in Figma, including auto layout, components and variables.

• Strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop (InDesign or Canva a plus).

• Solid grasp of UX principles, accessibility and responsive web design.

• Excellent written and spoken English, including clear async updates.

• Able to work independently, manage your own time and hit deadlines.

• Reliable high-speed internet, backup power and a quiet home workspace.

Nice to have

• Experience designing AI, chat or automation products.

• Background in B2B software.

• Motion graphics or video editing skills (After Effects, Premiere or CapCut).

• Basic HTML/CSS or experience with no-code site builders.

• Experience working with overseas clients or startups.

What we offer

• Stable, long-term remote contract with a fast-growing company.

• Real ownership: your work ships to customers and the market.

• Direct line to the founder and influence over product direction.

• [Paid time off, performance reviews and rate increases].

How to apply



1. A 2–3 minute video introduction (Loom, YouTube unlisted or Google Drive link) covering who you are, your design experience, and why this role suits you.

2. Your portfolio of SaaS work — product UI, dashboards and user flows you've designed, with your role in each project.

3. Any AI SaaS work, if available — AI, chat, voice or automation products you've designed for.

4. Your CV.

Our process: a 30-minute video call, a portfolio walkthrough, a short paid test task, and a final interview.

title: English-Spanish Medical Virtual Assistant | MA or Nurse | $6/hour
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

WellToDoor is launching a home medical visit service in New Jersey. We are looking for an experienced MA or nurse who speaks English and Spanish and wants a long-term role combining patient support with general office administration.



Our main dedicated office hours initially are Sunday-Thursday, 5-10 p.m. Eastern Time. Earlier daytime coverage mainly involves answering occasional calls and checking
s, with flexibility to step away from your desk between calls. You must remain reachable and have access to a private setting and the necessary systems when assisting patients.



The schedule below shows our business coverage needs. Tell us which hours you can consistently cover - we welcome applications even if you cannot cover every listed shift.



Starting pay is $6/hour, with a long-term opportunity to grow alongside the business. We value clear communication, accuracy, initiative, and follow-through.



THE ROLE

This position combines medical and patient support with secretary duties,
s, coordination, and light bookkeeping. Medical work will occupy part of your time; you must be comfortable handling general business administration as well.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Answer patient calls and messages professionally in English and Spanish.

- Collect demographics, medical history, and intake information using our forms and procedures.

- Accurately enter information into electronic medical records and prepare charts for provider review.

- Schedule and confirm appointments and follow up on missing information.

- Coordinate with patients, field technicians, office staff, and providers.

- Document communications and refer clinical questions to the appropriate provider.

- Manage
s, calendars, messages, and follow-ups.

- Communicate with staff, vendors, and business contacts.

- Organize documents, spreadsheets, and records.

- Perform light bookkeeping: record expenses, organize receipts, and track invoices and payments.

- Assist with other routine office duties.



Attention to detail matters. Include the reference DoorCare21 in your application subject line. Applications without this reference will not be considered.



INITIAL SCHEDULE - NEW JERSEY/U.S. EASTERN TIME

Total business coverage: 74 hours/week in winter; 71 hours/week in summer, including daytime phone availability.

Sunday-Thursday, 10 a.m.-5 p.m.: Primarily phone coverage and periodic
 checks. You do not need to sit at a desk throughout this period, but must remain reachable, answer calls promptly, and have access to a quiet, private setting and the systems needed to assist patients and record information.

Sunday-Thursday, 5 p.m.-10 p.m.: Dedicated working hours at your computer for intake, chart entry, scheduling, technician coordination,
s, and general administration.

Additional coverage needed:

- Friday: 8 a.m.-4 p.m.

- Saturday nights in winter: 6 p.m.-midnight.

- Saturday nights in summer: 10 p.m.-1 a.m. Sunday.

Our business operates on holidays. Hours follow U.S. Eastern daylight saving changes.



Please specify whether you can cover the full schedule or particular shifts. These are business coverage hours; your assigned shifts, breaks, time off, and compensation arrangements will be agreed before hiring. Daytime call volume is expected to be light initially and may grow. Changes to agreed hours or duties will be discussed in advance.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Excellent conversational and written English AND Spanish, including complete patient phone conversations in either language.

- Previous work experience as a medical assistant, including patient intake and chart documentation. A formal MA certificate is not required. Nurses with relevant intake and charting experience also qualify.

- U.S. medical practice experience strongly preferred.

- Experience with electronic medical records; identify the systems you have used.

- Strong organization, accurate data entry, professional phone communication, and ability to work independently.

- Comfortable with
, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and spreadsheets.

- Basic bookkeeping knowledge; QuickBooks experience is a plus.

- Understanding of patient confidentiality and ability to follow our privacy and security procedures.

- Reliable computer, headset, stable internet, private workspace, and backup connectivity.



PAY AND START DATE

Starting rate: $6 USD/hour. Payment arrangements for daytime phone availability, dedicated office hours, and any additional hours or applicable overtime will be confirmed before hiring.

Long-term remote opportunity. Expected start is soon; exact date to be confirmed.

Individual applicants only; no agencies.



HOW TO APPLY

To get started, send just:

1. Your resume showing your MA or nursing experience, including patient intake and charting.

2. Your available days and hours in U.S. Eastern Time.

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself: about 30-60 seconds in English and 30-60 seconds in Spanish.



We will discuss EMR experience, administrative and bookkeeping skills, equipment, references, and compensation details with shortlisted applicants. Shortlisted applicants will complete a live bilingual interview and a brief practical exercise using fictional patient information. Please do not submit actual patient records.



We look forward to meeting a capable, reliable assistant who can grow with WellToDoor.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Company: Zean Health – Home-Based Primary Care

Location: Remote 

Position Type: Part time to transition to Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a one-hour break

Experience Level: Experienced Medical Virtual Assistant (Healthcare Experience Required)



About Zean Health



Zean Health is a growing, physician-led home-based primary care practice serving patients in assisted living facilities, senior living communities, nursing facilities, and private residences in the United States.



Our mission is to provide accessible, compassionate, coordinated medical care to patients where they live.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and compassionate Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator to help manage daily administrative operations and coordinate communication between our medical providers, patients, families, and healthcare facilities.



This is not simply a scheduling or receptionist position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of administrative workflows, independently follow through on tasks, anticipate problems, and ensure that patient care requests are handled promptly and efficiently.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Care and Facility Coordination



Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for assisted living facilities, nursing homes, patients, and healthcare partners.



Receive incoming calls, messages, and requests from multiple healthcare facilities.



Accurately document requests for medication orders, laboratory testing, imaging, referrals, and other patient care needs.



Promptly communicate requests to the physician or appropriate clinical team member for review and authorization.



Track all requests from receipt through completion, ensuring that no orders or important communications are missed.



Follow up with facilities, pharmacies, laboratories, and other healthcare partners to confirm that authorized orders have been received and processed.



Escalate urgent clinical requests promptly according to established protocols.



Maintain professional, courteous, and timely communication with facility staff.



2. Phone Management and Patient Scheduling



Staff and manage the practice's phone line during assigned U.S. business hours.



Answer incoming calls professionally with excellent spoken English.



Schedule and coordinate patient appointments, including new admissions, post-hospital discharge visits, routine follow-ups, and urgent appointment requests.



Coordinate physician schedules across multiple assisted living and residential locations.



Confirm appointments and communicate scheduling updates to facilities and patients.



Maintain accurate scheduling records and assist with optimizing physician visit routes.



3. Insurance Verification and Patient Intake



Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits before scheduled appointments.



Confirm Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance information as applicable.



Identify insurance discrepancies and communicate potential coverage issues before visits.



Complete and organize patient registration and check-in documentation.



Obtain and track required intake forms, consents, demographic information, and relevant medical records.



Ensure patient charts are prepared and administrative documentation is complete before provider visits.



4. Electronic Health Record (EHR) Management



Monitor the EHR task inbox and incoming communications throughout the workday.



Perform a minimum of two structured EHR task and order sweeps daily to identify outstanding requests, incomplete tasks, and pending orders.



Track and follow up on outstanding orders until their status is resolved.



Upload, label, and attach incoming faxes and documents to the correct patient charts.



Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date patient records.



Flag incomplete documentation, outstanding referrals, and administrative issues requiring physician attention.



Ensure all patient information is handled confidentially in accordance with HIPAA requirements.



5. Fax and Referral Management



Monitor and clear the electronic fax inbox daily.



Download, categorize, and appropriately file incoming referrals, medical records, laboratory reports, and facility communications.



Respond to requests for medical records and administrative documentation within authorized workflows.



Track outgoing referrals and follow up on outstanding referral requests.



Ensure important documents reach the appropriate provider promptly.



6. Administrative Operations and Process Improvement



Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for front-desk operations, facility communication, scheduling, order tracking, and administrative workflows.



Help create training materials, checklists, and process documentation.



Maintain organized task lists and follow-up trackers.



Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.



Assist with additional administrative duties as needed.



Support occasional marketing, referral outreach, and practice growth activities.



Required Qualifications



Previous experience working as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Patient Care Coordinator, or similar healthcare support role.



Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication skills.



Experience handling incoming medical office calls and coordinating patient-related requests.



Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Ability to independently manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and follow through without constant supervision.



Familiarity with electronic health records, medical terminology, and healthcare administrative workflows.



Experience with U.S. medical insurance verification and patient scheduling.



Comfortable working U.S. business hours, including overnight or graveyard shifts in the Philippines.



Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, and appropriate equipment for remote work.



Professional, patient, compassionate, dependable, and solution-oriented.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting a U.S.-based primary care or home-based medical practice.



Previous experience coordinating with assisted living facilities, nursing homes, home health agencies, or post-acute care providers.



Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.



Experience managing physician orders, referrals, faxes, and EHR task queues.



Experience with DrChrono, or similar EHR systems.



Previous experience working overnight shifts supporting U.S. healthcare organizations.



Experience creating SOPs and improving medical office workflows.



What We Value



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Understands the importance of timely communication in patient care.



Is meticulous about following up on orders and unresolved requests.



Can manage competing priorities while remaining calm and professional.



Communicates respectfully with elderly patients, families, facility staff, and physicians.



Takes accountability for assigned tasks and provides clear updates.



Wants to grow with a developing medical practice.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit an application addressing all seven points below:



Professional Background: Briefly introduce yourself and describe your medical administrative or virtual assistant experience.



Healthcare Experience: Describe your experience working with U.S. medical practices, including any exposure to assisted living facilities, nursing homes, home-based primary care, or physician house-call services.



Insurance and EHR Experience: Explain your experience with insurance eligibility verification, Medicare or Medicaid, patient scheduling, and electronic health records. List the EHR systems you have used.



Care Coordination Experience: Describe how you have managed incoming patient requests, physician orders, referrals, and follow-ups. Include an example of how you ensured an important task was completed.



Graveyard Shift Experience: Describe your previous experience working overnight shifts, including how long you have worked U.S. business hours and your ability to maintain this schedule consistently.



English Video Introduction (Mandatory): Submit a 1–2 minute video of yourself speaking English. Introduce yourself, summarize your healthcare experience, and explain why you would be a good fit for this position. Applications without a video introduction will not be considered.



Availability and Compensation: State your earliest available start date, desired hourly or monthly compensation in USD, internet reliability, and whether you are seeking long-term full-time employment.



Important: Please begin your application with the words "Zean Care Coordinator" so we know you have carefully read the job description.



Join Our Team



At Zean Health, we believe that excellent patient care depends on excellent coordination behind the scenes.



We are looking for a dependable, compassionate professional who takes pride in keeping operations organized, supporting physicians, and helping patients receive timely care.



If you are experienced, proactive, and committed to providing outstanding administrative support, we would love to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

title: Paid Media Manager - Meta & Google Ads
description:
Paid Media Manager (Meta & Google Ads) Remote · Part-time · Independent Contractor



About us

Cocopiña makes feminine clothing for women who love to travel. We are a small US brand and we sell directly to our customers. We shoot all of our own photography and video, so there is a large, organized library to advertise with.



The job

This is a paid advertising role. You run our ad accounts and make them better. You d
 what runs, build and launch the ads, replace what has stopped working, and find what is holding performance back.



The heart of it is reading creative. You look at how individual ads performed and explain what caused the difference — the hook, the format, the angle, the line - and turn that into a recommendation for what we should run and what we should make next.



You will not be producing creative or working with influencers, but we do want creative input from you - angles worth trying, what a hook is missing, what we should shoot next.



Tools and process

We have our tools connected and automated processes set up to pull and analyze account data, including an AI analysis that runs weekly. Part of this job is refining them, and building the systems that keep ad performance improving rather than relying on anyone's memory of what worked.



Each week you report on what you are seeing and set the direction: what should run, what should come off, and what we need to create. You work directly with our creative team, telling them what the account needs and why, so that each round of creative is better than the last. Once it is produced, you build and launch the ads.



Requirements

- Managing Meta ad accounts for fashion or apparel brands at meaningful spend, with real testing experience

- Google Ads experience

- Triple Whale. It is our source of truth for performance across channels, and we work from it rather than from what each platform reports about itself

- You can explain why one ad beat another. "It got a 4x" is not an explanation

- You can write a recommendation specific enough for us to produce from

- You work without discounts, countdowns, or urgency tactics. We do not run them

- Steady judgment at lower order volumes, where a few unusual days are usually noise

- You work independently. We are not going to manage the account over your shoulder, and we need someone who runs it without being chased

- Available Mondays, and reliable with a weekly deadline



Preferred: you have shot, edited, or art-directed ads yourself. People who have made ads read performance differently, and we want that input.



Optional: Pinterest or TikTok advertising, and a working understanding of SEO.



AI

We use AI for analysis, reporting, and internal work. None of our visuals are AI-generated: every image and video is shot by us, and we do not use AI to alter or extend our photography.



To apply

Send us three things:

- Examples of ad accounts you improved - what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked

- Ad examples from your own work where one clearly beat the other, and why

- Your rate and your weekly availability

title: Instagram Social Media Manager | Engagement & Affiliate Outreach
description:
Optimum Formula is a research-use-only e-commerce company with an affiliate and ambassador program. We’re hiring a reliable, experienced Instagram Social Media Manager to handle daily engagement, strengthen affiliate relationships, and connect with potential new partners.



You should enjoy writing, understand how people interact on Instagram, and know how to join a conversation naturally. A thoughtful comment, a well-written introduction, and consistent follow-through are central to this role.



We provide a written engagement SOP and brand guidelines. We need someone who can learn the process, follow it carefully, and take ownership of the daily work.



POSITION DETAILS



• Remote, part-time position

• Approximately 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday

• $5 to $7.50 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Consistent daily availability, with working hours agreed before starting

• Some overlap with U.S. business hours for communication

• Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid skills exercise



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Engage with our affiliates and ambassadors



Review our priority affiliate accounts each workday. Like relevant posts and leave thoughtful, supportive, or witty comments that relate directly to the content.



Your comments should sound like a real person who actually read the caption or watched the video. Use humor when it fits, and adjust your tone to the person and conversation.



2. Find relevant conversations



Identify suitable posts and conversations within our approved fitness, health, and research topics.



Contribute comments that are relevant and useful. Follow our public-comment guidelines, including no peptide mentions, compound names, product promotion, discount codes, or promotional links.



Use good judgment about which conversations to join and which to leave alone.



3. Find and contact potential affiliates



Research creators and potential partners using our qualification guidelines. Consider their content, audience fit, quality of engagement, and existing partnerships.



Write personalized introductory messages that clearly identify Optimum Formula and explain the partnership opportunity using approved information.



Share the affiliate application link after someone expresses interest. Follow our follow-up process, respect declines, and keep each conversation organized.



4. Manage routine comments and messages



Check comments and DMs at the beginning and end of your scheduled workday.



Respond to routine questions using approved information. Pass customer service issues, sensitive questions, and anything outside your responsibilities to the appropriate team member.



Follow our research-use-only communication guidelines. Do not provide medical advice, dosing instructions, human-use recommendations, or unsupported product claims.



5. Track your work and report results



Maintain a simple activity and prospect tracker.



Submit a short daily update covering:



• Affiliate accounts reviewed and engagement completed

• New qualified prospects identified

• Outreach messages and follow-ups sent

• Replies and interested prospects

• Affiliate application links shared and confirmed applications

• Questions, opportunities, or issues needing attention



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Hands-on experience managing Instagram engagement, communities, or influencer outreach for a business

• Excellent written English with a natural, conversational style

• Good judgment about tone, timing, humor, and appropriate conversations

• Ability to follow a written SOP consistently

• Strong attention to detail and dependable daily communication

• Confidence using Google Sheets or a similar tracking tool

• Ability to work independently and apply feedback

• Reliable computer and internet connection



Experience with fitness, bodybuilding, wellness, or research-focused brands is helpful.



All engagement must be manual and personalized. We do not use purchased followers, engagement bots, repetitive bulk comments, or mass messaging.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Our priority affiliates receive consistent attention. Comments fit the posts they appear on. Suitable prospects receive thoughtful introductions. Interested partners receive timely follow-up, and the activity tracker clearly shows what happened and what comes next.



We value strong conversations, qualified interest, and reliable execution.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph. Begin your application with:



OF ENGAGEMENT



Please include the following:



1. Relevant experience



Share up to two Instagram accounts you have managed, or work samples you have permission to share. Explain what you personally handled and describe one result, including the timeframe. Confidential information may be removed.



2. Two sample comments



Write one short, natural comment for each of these posts:



• An existing affiliate celebrates a new deadlift personal record.

• A fitness creator shares how they stayed consistent during a busy week.



Keep each comment specific to the scenario. Do not mention products, peptides, discounts, or our affiliate program.



3. One sample outreach message



Write an introductory DM of no more than 60 words to a fitness educator you believe could be a suitable affiliate.



Introduce Optimum Formula as a research-use-only company and ask whether they would be interested in learning about the affiliate program. Do not include a link or invent product benefits.



4. A judgment question



Describe one situation where you would choose not to comment on a post, and explain why.



5. Availability

We’ll review your experience, writing samples, attention to detail, and judgment when selecting candidates for the next step.

title: Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

description:
