Estimating Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour unpaid break.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Estimating Assistant to support Advanced Framing Structures (AFS), a Southern California commercial rough-carpentry and wood-framing subcontractor. In this role, you will process bid invitations, download and organize project documents, maintain accurate bid records in HubSpot, and prepare plan files and overlays in PlanSwift. You will work closely with the estimating team to ensure bid opportunities, deadlines, and project documents are complete, organized, and ready for review. 



The ideal candidate has strong administrative processing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. Construction experience is helpful but not required. This is an administrative support role, not an independent estimating, pricing, or decision-making position.



Key Responsibilities:

Bid Invitation Administration

* Monitor assigned estimating
 inboxes, bid portals, and other sources for new Invitations to Bid (ITBs).

* Download bid invitations and related project documents, including plans, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and available project information.

* Enter or update bid opportunity information in HubSpot and other company tracking systems.

* Record bid due dates, project names, General Contractor information, locations, and other required opportunity details.

* Respond to bid invitations using approved company responses and direction from the estimating team.

* Record whether AFS intends to bid, decline, or requires estimator review before responding.

* Flag duplicate invitations, missing documents, unclear due dates, addenda, or other issues for estimator review.



Bid Document Organization

* Create and maintain organized electronic bid folders using AFS naming and filing standards.

* Save plans, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and other documents in the correct project folder.

* Maintain current versions of documents and clearly identify revised or superseded plan sets when directed.

* Notify the assigned estimator when new plans, addenda, or material bid documents are received.

* Help maintain an accurate and easy-to-follow electronic record for each bid opportunity.



PlanSwift Support

* Upload/import project plan sets into PlanSwift.

* Organize and label plan pages so estimators can locate drawings efficiently.

* Verify basic page orientation and plan-file completeness before handing the file to the estimator.

* Set up plan overlays to compare revised drawings against prior plan versions using the company's established process.

* Identify and flag apparent drawing changes shown by overlays for estimator review.

* Do not independently determine the estimating, scope, cost, or schedule impact of drawing changes.



HubSpot / CRM Administration

* Create and update bid opportunities, companies, contacts, due dates, stages, and activity information in HubSpot.

* Maintain clean and consistent CRM records and avoid duplicate companies, contacts, or opportunities.

* Update opportunity status based on direction from the estimating team.

* Assist with routine CRM data cleanup, record maintenance, and reporting support as assigned.

* HubSpot experience is preferred but not required, as training may be provided to candidates with strong administrative skills.



Estimating Team Support

* Maintain bid calendars, trackers, and administrative task lists as assigned.

* Assist estimators with locating, downloading, renaming, organizing, and distributing bid documents.

* Perform routine data entry and document-preparation tasks related to estimating.

* Follow up internally when information or direction is needed to complete an assigned administrative task.

* Support other routine estimating administrative work consistent with the level and purpose of the position.



Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

* Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, bid invitations, addenda, and general construction terminology.

* Experience using trackers, checklists, and standardized filing systems to maintain accurate records and prevent errors.

* Note: PlanSwift and HubSpot experience is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* This position focuses on administrative processing, document management, CRM maintenance, and plan preparation to support the estimating team.

* The employee will not make independent bid/no-bid decisions or determine which project scope should be included or excluded.

* Establishing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, markup, or final bid pricing is outside the scope of this role.

* Independent final quantity takeoffs, estimating approvals, pricing negotiations, and contract decisions are not part of the position.

* The employee must not submit final proposals or make commitments on behalf of AFS without authorization.

* Plan overlays are prepared to help identify drawing revisions. Determining their scope, cost, or scheduling impact is the responsibility of the estimator.

* Missing documents, conflicting information, unclear instructions, and unusual requests must be escalated to the assigned estimator or estimating leader.

* The employee is expected to maintain organized records, follow established procedures, and communicate progress or issues promptly to the estimating team.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

s and texts — answer routine questions, route anything clinical to the doctor

Excellent written and spoken English

Prior experience in a medical, chiropractic, or wellness practice

Send a short video of your smiling face telling us: (1) your experience with patient scheduling or admin work, (2) a time you caught a mistake before it became a problem, (3) your available hours (the office is open Monday thru Thursday 8:30am-6pm EST). The Role  

C9 is looking for an Azure API Management (APIM) Developer who will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and maintaining secure and scalable API solutions using Microsoft Azure API Management. You will work within an Agile team to implement API gateways, policies, integrations, security controls, and monitoring solutions, ensuring reliable API delivery that meets client requirements and follows established technical standards. 

There may be occasional involvement in client projects where your expertise is required, but the core purpose of this fixed-term role is to uplift C9's internal delivery capability. Responsibilities:

Design, configure, publish, and maintain APIs using Azure API Management.

Develop and manage APIM policies for authentication, authorization, transformation, routing, throttling, caching, and error handling.

Implement secure API access using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API keys, certificates, and Azure security services.

Configure API products, subscriptions, revisions, versions, named values, and related APIM components.

Integrate APIs with backend services, Azure services, applications, and third-party systems.

Monitor API performance, availability, errors, and usage, and troubleshoot issues affecting service reliability.

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes for APIM configurations using Azure DevOps.

Maintain API specifications, technical documentation, configuration standards, and deployment procedures.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Content Strategist (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working hours: 9am to 6pm SGT

Salary: SGD 1,000



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, working in trust-based markets where the people who win are the ones their audience already knows, likes and trusts before the first conversation ever happens. That's what they pay us to build.



This role owns that side of the business. You'll be the strategist behind our clients' brands: d
 what each client should stand for, what angles will make their market remember them, and what content gets made to build that authority month after month. Then you'll sit in front of the client and defend it. We're not hiring a content scheduler. We're hiring someone who can look at a financial advisor's or real estate agent's brand and say "here's why nobody remembers you, and here's what we're doing instead."



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our strategy team, ops manager, projects manager and creative team. Each client gets a real strategy, not a recycled template. Main platforms are
 and Instagram, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate — trust-based industries where the brand does the heavy lifting long before any pitch. Depending on the client, the end goal is winning clients or recruiting new team members, and your job is building the kind of presence that makes either one easier.



What you'll do

• Turn each client's positioning, audience and goals into a clear content strategy: what they stand for, what angles to hit, what to make

• Lead client calls as the strategy contact: present directions, run brainstorms, handle pushback, and keep clients aligned and confident

• Direct the creative team: give direction clear enough to execute without a second meeting, and review outputs against the strategy

• Review performance: spot which angles and formats are working, kill what isn't, and adjust the plan based on evidence

• Keep every client's strategy on track: make sure what gets produced actually follows the direction set, and flag drift or gaps early before they cost results



How you'll be measured

Brand growth and client confidence. Clients whose authority and presence visibly grow — stronger positioning, growing reach, content their market actually engages with and remembers. And clients who renew because they can feel the strategy working. You'll run insights calls with clients to review whether the strategy is delivering — and adjust when it isn't. If you'd rather be measured on outcomes than on how many posts went out, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Think in brand outcomes first: you ask "what does this client need to be known for?" before you ask "what should we post?"

• Can walk into a client call, present a direction, and hold your ground when it's challenged—with reasoning, not stubbornness

• Study why a piece of content worked, not just that it worked

• Give creatives feedback that makes the work better, not just different

• Communicate proactively. Clients and the team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Think strategy means a content calendar with theme days

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Chase trends for their own sake. A trending format that doesn't fit a financial advisor's positioning is a distraction, not a strategy

• Avoid client-facing pressure. Presenting, defending and realigning is half this job



No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've built content strategies for service professionals or personal brands

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors, insurance or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Real ownership of strategy, working directly with the founder and clients — not three layers removed from the decisions

• Your strategies run on real accounts with real stakes. You see whether your thinking works, fast

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Room to grow into a head of strategy role as the agency scales



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Strategist - [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of experience in content or social media strategy and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: 2 to 3 accounts or campaigns you've shaped the strategy for, with a few sentences on each explaining what the strategy was and what it achieved

• One short exercise: find one financial advisor or real estate agent posting content on Instagram or TikTok (any market). In a few lines, tell us what's holding their brand back and the first thing you'd change. We're looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD only

Trident Digital

About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest-growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry. They don’t pay us for flashy edits. They pay us to make them look like the most credible name in their market, so clients and recruits come to them.

You’ll edit talking-head content, educational videos, testimonials, interviews, ads, and event trailers that go live on our clients’ pages.



How the contract works

- The contract runs for 1 month to start

- At the end of the month, we review two things: the quality of your edits and your output volume

- If both are strong and the workload is still there, we extend for another month

- No guesswork. You’ll know what we’re measuring from day one



This role is open to CapCut editors only

Our workflow, templates and team all run on CapCut. We’re not looking for Premiere Pro editors who also “know CapCut.” We’re looking for people who can make CapCut edits look premium: clean cuts, good pacing, sharp captions, and motion that supports the message instead of distracting from it.



What the setup looks like

You’ll work with our creative team (strategists, scriptwriters, videographers and designers) and our projects manager, who will brief you and review your work. Main platforms are Instagram and
, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Most content is short-form vertical video. Clients are financial advisors and real estate agents, which means the edit has to build trust, not just grab attention.



What you’ll do

- Edit short-form talking-head videos, educational content, testimonials, interviews, ads and event trailers based on briefs

- Cut for pace and retention: a strong first 3 seconds, no dead air, and a reason for every cut

- Add captions, B-roll, simple motion graphics, intros and outros in CapCut

- Follow each client’s brand style so their content looks consistent across every post

- Submit edits for review, take feedback and turn revisions around quickly

- Keep all project files (raw footage, edits, templates) organised and stored in our shared library



How you’ll be measured

- Quality: how often your edits pass review on the first round, with minimal revisions

- Quantity: 6 to 10 short-form videos a week, depending on complexity

- Turnaround: delivering edits and revisions on time



You’ll see these numbers weekly. They d
 whether the contract is extended.



You’ll do well here if you

- Know CapCut inside out and can make it look better than most people make Premiere look

- Understand that the edit serves the message. The speaker’s credibility comes first, effects come second

- Can work fast without getting sloppy

- Take feedback well. Your edits get reviewed and sometimes reworked. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

- Mainly edit in Premiere Pro, DaVinci or Final Cut and only use CapCut occasionally

- Can’t commit your full working hours (9AM–6PM SGT) for the contract period

- Rely on trending templates and heavy effects instead of thinking about pacing and story

- Need long turnaround times on each video

No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- You’ve edited content for personal brands, coaches or service professionals

- Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

- Biggest bonus: you’ve edited for the Singapore market

title: Business Development Associate (WFH / Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote (Work from Home) | Performance-based

Salary: SGD 300 base + performance bonus (total est. SGD 500–1,000 with commissions)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Every client we work with started as a conversation someone had to start, and a follow-up someone didn't drop. This role owns both.

This is a sales role, not an admin role. You'll reach out to new prospects every day, chase the leads that come in until they book a call with us, and make sure nobody who enquires is left waiting. Your pay scales with your effort and speed: more outreach, faster follow-ups and quicker replies mean you earn more.

If you're fast, reliable, and not afraid to me.



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our BD lead and the founder, so you'll see up close how deals move from first message to signed client. Prospects are financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. You own your outreach and follow-up approach: test what works, drop what doesn't, and keep sharpening it.



What you’ll handle

- Daily outreach. Build lead lists and reach out to prospects every day with personalised messages that give them a real reason to reply

- Lead follow-up. Follow up on leads from our lead sources until they respond and book a call with us

- WhatsApp replies and reminders. Reply to enquiries quickly, send call reminders, and handle reschedules and no-shows

- Tracking. Keep the CRM and tracking sheet up to date, so every prospect, reply and booking is logged



How this role works

- Outreach happens every day, with no misses. Consistency is the job

- Leads don't keep office hours. Enquiries and bookings come in on evenings and weekends too, and you need to be responsive whenever they do. A lead that waits goes cold

- Your pay follows your output. Commissions are tied to results, and you'll see your numbers every week



How you’ll be measured

Outreach sent, follow-ups completed, response speed on enquiries, and calls booked (and shown up to) for the BD lead.



You’ll do well here if you

- Are responsive and on the ball. When a lead messages, you reply. No gaps

- Are motivated by earning more through effort, not by clocking in hours

- Figure out what works instead of waiting to be told. If a message isn't getting replies, you change it

- Are well-spoken and articulate, in writing and out loud. You'd like to grow into handling calls yourself

- Write like a human. Your messages read like a real person, not a template blast

- Sweat the small stuff: names spelled right, reminders sent on time, tracker always current

- Don't take silence personally. Most people won't reply. The ones who do are why the job exists



This is not for you if you

- Want fixed hours where your phone goes off at 6pm and on weekends

- Prefer a steady salary over pay that grows with your effort

- Get discouraged after a week of no's. Resilience isn't optional here, it's the job

- Have freelance work or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- Sales, BD, outreach or lead generation experience, even informally

- Comfortable with WhatsApp, Google Sheets and CRM tools

- You've handled high message volume without letting quality slip

Fresh grads are welcome to apply. We care more about reliability and hunger than years of experience.



What you get

- Direct exposure to the founder and BD lead. You learn how deals are won, not just how messages are sent

- Commissions that grow with your results, so your ceiling is set by your effort

- A clear path into handling calls and moving into full sales and BD roles as the agency scales

- A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses and overseas team trips



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Business Development Associate - [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

- Cover letter: a bit about yourself and why this role fits you

- Updated CV/Resume

- One short exercise: write the first outreach message you'd send to a financial advisor to start a conversation about working with a marketing agency. Keep it short, the kind of message you'd actually send. We're looking at how you write and how you think

- Expected salary in SGD only



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Wix Conversion & Optimisation Specialist — Human Frequency
description:
Wix Conversion & Optimisation Specialist — Human Frequency



Human Frequency is looking for a Wix specialist who understands what makes a landing page effective and how to use Wix to support enquiries and bookings.



We need someone who can review our pages and the systems behind them, identify what’s working, explain what needs improving and help us make better use of the platform.



This role focuses on auditing, optimisation and Wix configuration. Website development, coding and design production are not your responsibility. You will need enough understanding of effective page design to give clear recommendations to the people doing that work.



What you’ll do

- Review our landing pages and booking journey

- Assess how visitors move from the landing page through buttons, forms and booking steps to confirmation. Identify confusing instructions, unnecessary steps, broken links or other issues that could prevent someone from enquiring or booking.

- Recommend improvements to page presentation

- Review headline readability, font size and weight, capitalisation, spacing, content hierarchy, button placement and mobile usability. Explain how your recommendations could help visitors understand the offer and take the next step.

- We want recommendations supported by evidence and sensible testing, rather than blanket rules about what always converts.

- Review and improve Wix settings and automations

- Understand how our forms, bookings, contact records, confirmation
s and reminders connect. Identify missing, duplicated or incorrect actions, and configure improvements using Wix’s built-in tools. Flag anything that requires a developer or another specialist.

- Audit and improve SEO

- Review page titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, URLs, internal links, image descriptions, indexing and relevant Wix SEO settings. Identify opportunities to improve visibility for the people and locations we serve.

- Review tracking and performance

- Check how we measure page visits, button clicks, enquiries and bookings. Identify gaps in tracking and help us understand where visitors drop off. Clearly distinguish what the data shows from what still needs testing.

- Help us use Wix more effectively

- Identify useful Wix features we could use better. Explain the benefit, priority and any limitations before recommending additional tools or changes.



What we need from you

Strong practical knowledge of Wix, including landing pages, forms, bookings, automations, SEO and analytics.

The ability to assess conversion and usability without needing to design or code the website yourself.

Clear recommendations showing what to keep, fix, improve and test.

The ability to explain technical issues in simple language and work with our team.

Honest judgement about what you know, what needs checking and when another specialist is needed.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Sales Specialist (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **highly skilled Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer** to join our team long-term.



This is **not primarily a cold-calling position**. Our marketing and lead-generation team identifies homeowners who have expressed interest in selling and pre-qualifies them before handing qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Specialist.



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with motivated homeowners, understand their situation, build trust, negotiate pricing and terms, follow up consistently, and ultimately **get profitable real estate contracts signed**.



We currently generate seller opportunities through multiple channels, including **iSpeedToLead, DataSift, SMS marketing, Smarter Contact, Kixie, and our CRM**. Our goal is to build a highly systemized acquisition department where qualified seller opportunities are contacted quickly and no valuable lead falls through the cracks.



Our primary transaction strategy is **novation**, followed by wholesale/assignment when appropriate. We selectively purchase properties ourselves when the profit opportunity is exceptional.



You will work closely with our current Acquisition Manager, operations team, lead-generation team, and company owner. Initially, you will learn our existing acquisition process and work alongside our current Acquisition Manager. The goal is for you to eventually become capable of **independently managing and closing qualified seller opportunities from beginning to end**.



### Responsibilities & Expectations



- Call qualified homeowners who have indicated an interest in selling.

- Respond quickly to newly qualified seller opportunities.

- Build rapport and uncover the seller's true motivation, timeline, condition, financial situation, and desired outcome.

- Negotiate purchase prices and transaction structures professionally and confidently.

- Explain cash offers, novation transactions, and other selling solutions clearly to homeowners.

- Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately.

- Work leads through the CRM until they sell, contract with us, or are otherwise no longer viable.

- Use **Kixie** for outbound calling and follow-up.

- Maintain detailed CRM notes so another team member can immediately understand each seller's situation.

- Work closely with the lead-qualification team to improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisitions.

- Bring complicated or unusually valuable opportunities to management for deal review.

- Participate in call reviews, coaching, and ongoing sales training.

- Become capable of covering for the Acquisition Manager when he is unavailable.

- Ultimately produce approximately **4–6 signed contracts per month** once fully trained and supplied with adequate qualified lead volume.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is **comfortable talking about money, asking difficult questions, negotiating, handling objections, and asking homeowners to make decisions**.



The ideal candidate has prior experience in **U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, investor sales, high-ticket telephone sales, or another negotiation-heavy sales position**.



Excellent spoken English is extremely important. You should sound natural, confident, professional, empathetic, and trustworthy when speaking with U.S. homeowners.



You should also be:



- Highly dependable and available during agreed U.S. business hours.

- Competitive but ethical.

- Persistent without being aggressive.

- Comfortable receiving coaching and having calls reviewed.

- Organized with strong CRM discipline.

- Able to follow a sales process while still thinking independently.

- Comfortable making numerous follow-up calls every day.

- Able to recognize seller motivation and negotiate creatively.

- Comfortable discussing property values, mortgages, equity, repairs, and seller expectations.

- Motivated by measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



## What This Job Is NOT



This is not a position where success is measured by simply making a large number of calls.



We care about:



**Qualified seller conversations → signed contracts → closed transactions → gross profit.**



Our lead-generation team will do much of the initial prospecting and qualification. Your job is to take valuable seller opportunities and **convert them into contracts**.



## Training & Growth



You will initially work closely with our existing Acquisition Manager and review real seller conversations, successful deals, objection handling, negotiation strategies, and our novation process.



We are building redundancy into our acquisition department, so our objective is to have **multiple Acquisition Specialists capable of independently closing deals at a high level**.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on significantly more responsibility as the company grows.



## Schedule



**Full-time position.**



You must be able to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours and be available when homeowners are most likely to answer their phones.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## Compensation



**Competitive base compensation plus performance incentives/bonuses based on results.**



Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skill.



Top performers should have the opportunity to earn substantially more as their contract production increases.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short explanation of your previous sales, real estate, acquisitions, or negotiation experience.

2. Your experience speaking with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your experience using CRMs and telephone dialing systems.

4. Your experience with real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, novations, or motivated sellers, if applicable.

5. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful negotiating with U.S. homeowners.

6. Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

7. Your internet speed and backup internet/power setup.

8. Put the words **“Acquisition Closer”** in the subject line of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



**VOICE RECORDING MANDATORY**. Since this person's job is almost entirely seller communication,

title: Events Administrator
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.

We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.



The Role



The Event Administrator provides administrative, research, and project coordination support to our Accounts Department.



The primary goal of this position is simple: take ownership of repeatable, time-consuming, and process-driven work so our Account Managers can spend more time with clients, solving problems, making strategic decisions, and growing accounts.



This person will help keep projects organized, conduct initial vendor and venue research, maintain project documentation, support proposals, track outstanding items, and make sure important administrative details do not fall through the cracks.



This is not a client account management position. It is a support role designed for someone who is highly organized, resourceful, responsive, and excellent at following through.



About You



You take pride in making sure the department is organized and operations flow seamlessly. Your zone of genius is bringing order to complexity and finding ways to make processes more efficient. You naturally notice when something could be organized better, simplified, documented, or improved.



We work in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are real, and priorities can shift quickly. You will need to be comfortable managing several requests at once while staying organized, calm, responsive, and detail-oriented.



You do not just complete tasks. You think about how the work gets done. If you see the team repeating the same manual process over and over, you look for a better way. If information is difficult to find, you organize it. If a process is unclear, you help document it. If something is falling through the cracks, you create a system to prevent it from happening again.



You genuinely enjoy being the person behind the scenes who helps the entire department operate better.



You understand events and thrive in a fast-paced environment where multiple projects are moving at once, deadlines are tight, and priorities can change quickly. You know how to shift gears while staying organized, calm, and focused on the details that matter.



You are also a strong researcher. If an Account Manager asks you to research five venues, you understand that sending five website links is not enough. You gather the information needed to make a decision, including availability, capacity, location, pricing, restrictions, included services, and other important event considerations.



You are proactive about follow-through. When you are waiting on a quote, COI, W-9, contract, or answer from a vendor, you follow up without needing to be reminded.



You understand that small details can become large event problems. You take pride in being someone the team can trust to keep information organized, accurate, and moving forward.



Most importantly, you enjoy helping others work more efficiently. When you are doing your job well, Account Managers have more time to focus on their clients, solve problems, think strategically, and grow their accounts.



What You Will Own



Accounts Department Administration

Help keep the Accounts Department organized and operating consistently across projects.

• Create new project folders in Dropbox using established folder structures.

• Manage and maintain account and project folders in Dropbox, ensuring files are organized, current, and easy for the team to access.

• Archive, remove, and maintain project folders as needed.

• Maintain organized project documentation and file naming.

• Support contract administration and document organization.

• Maintain and update the agency's vendor database and vendor lists.

• Organize and maintain department SOPs, templates, and process documents.

• Help ensure teams are using the most current versions of templates and documents.

• Serve as the administrative owner of assigned department perks, policies, trackers, or recurring processes.

• Identify missing information or outstanding administrative items and follow up without waiting to be asked.

• Support new client, project, and vendor onboarding processes.

• Coordinate and track Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and other required event documentation.

• Maintain project trackers, timelines, contact lists, and administrative records.

• Assist with data entry, document preparation, scheduling, and other administrative needs.

• Help ensure project information is accurately documented and communicated internally



Goal: Create consistent administrative systems so Account Managers do not have to spend their time maintaining them.



Vendor Research & Event Logistics Support



Take the first pass at research and coordination work that can consume significant Account Manager time.

• Research venues and vendors based on project requirements.

• Research restaurants, transportation, gifting, entertainment, staffing, rentals, and other event needs.

• Research venues, caterers, rental companies, entertainment, production partners, promotional vendors, and other event resources.

• Request and organize vendor quotes, pricing, availability, and capabilities.

• Follow up with vendors and partners to obtain outstanding information and documentation.

• Gather quotes and supporting information.

• Build organized vendor and venue comparison sheets.

• Assist with vendor onboarding.

• Collect and organize Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, contracts, menus, specifications, and other required documents.

• Track vendor confirmations, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Follow up on missing vendor information and documentation.

• Assist with shipping, receiving, and inventory tracking.

• Maintain organized vendor information for future agency use.

• Flag incomplete information, missed deadlines, pricing changes, or other potential issues to the appropriate Account Manager.

• Create vendor comparison documents and research summaries.

• Assist with tracking event logistics, including shipping, deliveries, rentals, load-in/load-out, staffing, and vendor requirements.



Goal: Account Managers should be reviewing options and making decisions rather than spending hours gathering basic information.



Project & Administrative Coordination



Keep every assigned project organized and moving.

• Update project timelines, task lists, and trackers.

• Track deadlines and outstanding items.

• Follow up with internal team members and vendors on assigned deliverables.

• Schedule internal, client, and vendor meetings.

• Assist with meeting preparation, notes, recaps, and follow-up items.

• Take clear meeting notes and document next steps.

• Assign and track action items based on meeting direction.

• Organize project folders, decks, contracts, budgets, and event documents.

• Maintain project contact lists.

• Maintain event and project calendars.

• Assist with guest lists, registration information, and attendee data when needed.

• Help prepare event documents such as production schedules, staffing information, and run-of-show documents.

• Proactively identify missing information or upcoming deadlines and follow up as needed.

• Support Account Managers with day-to-day project coordination.

• Help maintain project information and updates within company systems.



Goal: Nothing falls through the cracks.



Proposal & Deck Support



Support the Accounts and Sales teams with the research and administrative work required to develop strong proposals.

• Review notes from sales and discovery calls.

• Pull key information from call notes and organize it into an initial proposal framework.

• Draft initial proposal documents for Account Manager review.

• Research vendors, venues, products, and event elements required for proposals.

• Request preliminary quotes and pricing.

• Prepare venue selection decks.

• Prepare initial event scope documents.

• Build vendor and venue comparison documents.

• Organize photos, specifications, pricing, and supporting materials.

• Update existing proposal templates.

• Organize and maintain proposal templates in Canva, Dropbox, and other agency systems.

• Check proposals for missing information, inconsistent formatting, outdated information, or incomplete sections before Account Manager review.



The Event Administrator prepares the first pass. The Account Manager remains responsible for strategy, recommendations, final pricing, client communication, and final approval.



Goal: Give Account Managers a strong starting point instead of requiring them to build every proposal and research document from scratch.



Contract & Documentation Support

• Organize client and vendor contracts.

• Track contract status and outstanding signatures.

• Maintain current versions of contracts and related documents.

• Collect required vendor documentation.

• Maintain COI records and follow up on missing or incorrect certificates.

• Collect and organize W-9s.

• Maintain menus, venue specifications, vendor specifications, and other project documents.

• Flag missing documentation before project deadlines.

• Support project closeout and document archiving.



Shipping & Inventory Support

• Create and maintain shipping trackers.

• Track shipments and delivery status.

• Maintain inventory lists for assigned projects.

• Confirm delivery addresses and receiving instructions.

• Organize tracking numbers and shipping documentation.

• Follow up on delayed or missing shipments.

• Flag shipping issues immediately to the appropriate project owner.



What This Role Does NOT Own



To keep responsibilities clear, the Event Administrator supports the work but does not replace the Account Manager or Event Manager.

• Client relationship management.

• Event strategy and creative direction.

• Final vendor selection.

• Negotiating significant vendor terms.

• Final event budgets and financial decisions.

• Client recommendations.

• Scope changes.

• Major production decisions.

• Managing client expectations.

• Overall event execution and results.

• Growing and retaining client accounts.

The Event Administrator's job is to gather, organize, track, prepare, and follow through so the project owner can make better and faster decisions.



What Success Looks Like

• Account Managers spend less time on repetitive administrative work.

• Project folders and documentation are consistently organized.

• Vendor research arrives organized and ready for review.

• Quotes and preliminary information are collected on time.

• COIs, W-9s, contracts, and vendor documents are complete and easy to locate.

• Project trackers accurately reflect current status.

• Follow-ups happen without Account Managers repeatedly asking.

• Proposal first drafts are organized and reduce preparation time.

• Vendor and venue comparison sheets make decisions easier.

• Deadlines and outstanding items are consistently tracked.

• Potential problems are flagged early.

• Account Managers trust that when something is assigned to you, it will be followed through to completion.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional event, experiential marketing, event production, hospitality, or event coordination experience required; 3 to 4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience supporting the planning and execution of live events.

• Working knowledge of the event planning process, including venues, vendors, timelines, budgets, contracts, logistics, and onsite execution.

• Thrives in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple projects moving at the same time.

• Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong online research skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.

• Comfortable following established SOPs and processes.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

• Experience with Dropbox preferred.

• Experience with Canva preferred.

• Comfortable learning project management, event, and agency technology platforms.

• Experience researching vendors, venues, restaurants, travel, or events is a plus.

• Experience with event proposals, vendor documents, COIs, W-9s, or contracts is a plus.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative.



Our Core Values



WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

PROACTIVE: We are proactive to take the initiative to go above and beyond our job responsibilities. We are self-motivated and seek opportunities to make a positive impact.

FUN + ENGAGEMENT: We create a positive work environment that fosters associate and client satisfaction, engagement, creativity and productivity.

GROWTH: For IMG to grow, we must each learn and grow. We are humble and open to new ideas as our world is constantly growing.

INNOVATION: We are committed to a culture of innovation, forward thinking and adaptability, which can contribute to long-term success and growth.

COMMUNITY: We give our time and resources to support each other and our communities.

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity).
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound and inbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



20 hours per week across 7 days.

Current Schedule (Pacific Time):



Monday–Friday:

- 11:00–11:30 AM

- 12:30–1:30 PM

- 4:00–6:00 PM



Saturday–Sunday:

- 10:00–11:15 AM



Important: This is a split shift schedule, and weekend availability is required.



Hours may change seasonally based on the studio's needs, with shifts scheduled between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Any changes will be discussed and agreed upon in advance.



We are looking for someone who can reliably work the current schedule and has reasonable flexibility for future adjustments.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD (Paid)



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

title: Event Designer
description:
About Innovate Marketing Group



Innovate Marketing Group is an experiential marketing and events agency creating meaningful brand experiences that bring people together. From corporate events and conferences to experiential activations, VIP experiences, and multi-city programs, our team manages the details that turn ideas into memorable experiences.



We believe great events come from great people, thoughtful planning, strong communication, and an obsession with delivering WOW service.

 

The Role



Innovate Marketing Group is seeking a creative, detail-oriented Event Designer to translate event concepts, client objectives, and brand identities into compelling visual experiences. 



This position will work closely with our account management and production teams to develop creative concepts, event layouts, visual presentations, branded environments, activations, stages, booths, signage, and other experiential elements. 



We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with real-world event execution. The ideal candidate understands that event design is not only about creating beautiful visuals - it also requires consideration of venue dimensions, budgets, materials, production capabilities, guest flow, brand guidelines, and client feedback. 



About You



You are a creative thinker who loves bringing ideas to life through thoughtful, visually compelling event design. You understand that great event design is not just about making something look beautiful—it is about creating an experience that supports the client’s goals, tells a story, and leaves a lasting impression on guests.



You thrive in a fast-paced event agency environment where multiple projects are moving at the same time, deadlines are tight, and creative direction can evolve quickly. You are comfortable shifting between projects, incorporating feedback, making revisions, and working within real-world timelines and budgets without losing sight of the creative vision.



You have a strong eye for design, scale, proportion, color, materials, branding, and spatial flow. When you receive a creative brief, you do not simply make something visually appealing. You think about how guests will enter the space, what they will see first, how they will move through the experience, where key brand moments should happen, and how every element works together.



You understand that event design also needs to be buildable and functional. A beautiful rendering is only successful if it can actually be produced. You consider venue restrictions, dimensions, fabrication methods, materials, installation requirements, guest capacity, accessibility, sightlines, traffic flow, and budget when developing your designs.



You are resourceful and solutions-oriented. If the initial creative direction is outside the budget, you do not simply remove elements—you think creatively about how to achieve a similar look and impact through different materials, finishes, rentals, layouts, or fabrication methods.



You are also a strong researcher. You look for inspiration, emerging event and design trends, materials, furniture, décor, fabrication techniques, experiential activations, and new ways brands are engaging their audiences. You know how to take inspiration and turn it into something original and appropriate for the client rather than simply recreating what has already been done.



You pay close attention to brand guidelines and understand how to translate a brand into a physical environment. You can take a client’s colors, typography, messaging, personality, and campaign creative and thoughtfully extend them across signage, stages, activations, décor, environmental graphics, and other event touchpoints while maintaining brand consistency.



You welcome feedback and understand that revisions are a normal part of the creative process. You do not become overly attached to one idea. You listen carefully to feedback from clients, Account Managers, vendors, and leadership, ask questions when something is unclear, and use that feedback to strengthen the design.



You are detail-oriented and take ownership of your work. Before submitting a deck, rendering, floor plan, or design file, you review it carefully for spelling, alignment, dimensions, branding, consistency, and overall presentation. You understand that even small mistakes can impact client confidence or create larger production issues later.



You are proactive about communication and follow-through. If you are missing dimensions, brand assets, venue information, or other details needed to complete your work, you ask for them early rather than waiting until the deadline. If you identify a potential production challenge, you flag it and help find a solution.



Most importantly, you genuinely enjoy transforming ideas into experiences. When you are doing your job well, the team can confidently present creative concepts that excite clients, differentiate IMG, can realistically be produced, and ultimately create memorable experiences for the people attending them.



Key Responsibilities 



Event Concept & Creative Development 

• Develop creative concepts and visual directions for corporate events, experiential activations, conferences, pop-ups, exhibits, and branded experiences. 

• Translate client briefs, objectives, and brand guidelines into cohesive event environments. 

• Create mood boards, inspiration boards, color palettes, and overall design directions. 

• Brainstorm creative event elements, installations, photo moments, stages, signage, displays, and guest experiences. 



Event Renderings & Layouts 



• Develop event renderings, floor plans, layouts, elevations, and visual mockups. 

• Create realistic representations of event spaces to help clients visualize proposed concepts. 

• Design stages, booths, registration areas, lounges, product displays, branded environments, and other event elements. 

• Revise designs efficiently based on client and internal team feedback. 



Presentation & Proposal Support 



• Create polished visual materials for client presentations, proposals, pitches, and RFP responses. 

• Work with the account team to ensure creative concepts align with the project's objectives, budget, venue, and production requirements. 

• Help communicate design concepts clearly through presentations and supporting visuals. 

Production Collaboration 

• Prepare artwork, specifications, dimensions, and other design information needed by production partners. 

• Collaborate with fabricators, printers, rental companies, and other vendors to ensure designs can be realistically produced. 

• Review proofs and production materials for visual accuracy. 

• Make design adjustments when required by venue, budget, timeline, or fabrication constraints. 



What Success Looks Like



• Creative concepts are visually compelling, thoughtful, and aligned with the client’s brand, objectives, audience, and overall event strategy.

• Account Managers can confidently present your creative work to clients with minimal revisions or cleanup. 

• Initial concepts and design drafts are delivered on time and allow enough time for internal review before client deadlines. 

• Renderings, floor plans, mood boards, and presentation decks clearly communicate the creative vision and help clients understand how the experience will come to life. 

• Designs are not only beautiful but also realistic, functional, and buildable within the approved budget, venue restrictions, timeline, and production requirements. 

• Client brand guidelines are consistently and accurately reflected across event environments, signage, stages, activations, décor, and other visual touchpoints. 

• Design files are organized, clearly labeled, current, and easy for the internal team and production partners to locate and understand. 

• Revisions are completed accurately and efficiently, with feedback incorporated thoroughly rather than requiring the same corrections multiple times. 

• Vendor and fabrication partners receive clear creative direction, dimensions, specifications, reference materials, and production-ready information when required. 

• Potential design, fabrication, spatial, budget, or production challenges are identified and communicated early. 

• You proactively provide creative solutions and alternatives when an original idea is not feasible due to budget, venue, timeline, or production limitations. 

• Your work consistently demonstrates strong attention to detail, including spelling, alignment, scale, dimensions, branding, finishes, materials, and overall presentation. 

• Account Managers trust that when a creative assignment is given to you, you will take ownership of it, communicate proactively, meet the deadline, and follow it through to completion. 

• Your creative work helps IMG deliver memorable experiences, strengthen client relationships, and win new business.



Qualifications



• 2+ years of professional experience in event design, experiential design, environmental design, spatial design, production design, or a related creative field required; 3–4 years strongly preferred.

• Prior experience designing for live events, experiential marketing activations, conferences, corporate events, brand experiences, trade shows, pop-ups, or similar environments strongly preferred.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating event, experiential, spatial, environmental, or related design work.

• Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including composition, color, typography, scale, proportion, hierarchy, materials, and spatial flow.

• Ability to translate a creative brief, client objective, or initial idea into a cohesive visual concept and physical experience.

• Ability to interpret floor plans, venue dimensions, measurements, and spatial requirements.

• Understanding of real-world event production considerations, including fabrication, rentals, materials, installation, venue restrictions, guest flow, sightlines, accessibility, and budget.

• Experience creating event renderings, floor plans, elevations, mood boards, presentation decks, environmental graphics, and other visual materials used to communicate creative concepts.

• Proficiency in relevant professional design and rendering software, such as Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, or comparable programs.

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and/or InDesign preferred.

• Experience with 3D modeling and rendering software strongly preferred.

• Proficiency with Canva preferred.

• Experience preparing or organizing production-ready artwork and files for printers, fabricators, signage vendors, and other production partners is a plus.

• Strong visual research skills and the ability to identify relevant trends, materials, furnishings, décor, fabrication techniques, and experiential inspiration.

• Strong understanding of branding and the ability to translate brand guidelines into physical environments and experiences.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to reviewing work carefully before internal or client presentation.

• Comfortable receiving creative direction and feedback and making multiple rounds of revisions when necessary.

• Thrives in a fast-paced agency environment with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple projects moving simultaneously.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills.

• Comfortable collaborating closely with Account Managers, production partners, vendors, fabricators, and other members of the creative team.

• Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to develop creative alternatives when budget, timing, venue, or production limitations affect the original concept.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying highly communicative, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable learning and using project management, file-sharing, event, and agency technology platforms.

Our Core Values

WOW SERVICE: We are committed to great operations. Being accountable, a trusted advisor, and results oriented.

PROACTIVE: We are proactive to take the initiative to go above and beyond our job responsibilities. We are self-motivated and seek opportunities to make a positive impact.

FUN + ENGAGEMENT: We create a positive work environment that fosters associate and client satisfaction, engagement, creativity and productivity.

GROWTH: For IMG to grow, we must each learn and grow. We are humble and open to new ideas as our world is constantly growing.

INNOVATION: We are committed to a culture of innovation, forward thinking and adaptability, which can contribute to long-term success and growth.

COMMUNITY: We give our time and resources to support each other and our communities.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Sales Representative - Party Rental Business







## Company Overview







Join our vibrant team at Jax Party Company, a leading party rental business known for providing exceptional service and top-quality equipment for events of all sizes. We are committed to making every celebration memorable, and we’re looking for a motivated Sales Representative to help us achieve that goal.







## Position Overview







As a Sales Representative, you will play a crucial role in driving sales and building lasting relationships with our clients. This is a full-time position, Monday through Friday, from 8 AM to 6 PM, and every other Saturday from 8am-3pm (US Eastern Time Zone).







## Key Responsibilities







- **Client Interaction:** Engage with potential customers via phone, email, and in-person meetings to understand their event needs and provide tailored rental solutions.







- **Sales Process:** Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals. Follow up on leads and opportunities, ensuring timely responses to inquiries.







- **Product Knowledge:** Maintain a thorough understanding of our rental inventory, including tents, tables, chairs, linens, and other event accessories, to effectively promote our services.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
About the Role

This is not a traditional content writing position. We are looking for someone who understands direct response marketing, consumer psychology, and the art of selling through words.



You will be responsible for developing compelling copy for
 marketing campaigns, landing pages, sales funnels, and other customer-facing marketing initiatives.



Beyond writing, you will play an active role in creative ideation, developing marketing angles, identifying customer pain points, and testing new messaging strategies that drive conversions.



The ideal candidate is both a strong writer and a creative thinker who can independently research products, identify opportunities, and develop persuasive marketing concepts.



Key Responsibilities



Copywriting & Content Development

Write compelling, conversion-focused copy for
 campaigns, landing pages, product pages, and sales funnels.

Develop persuasive headlines, hooks, calls to action, and promotional messaging designed to drive customer engagement and sales.

Create engaging
 sequences for product launches, promotional campaigns, customer retention, and abandoned cart recovery.

Translate complex supplement ingredients, product benefits, and scientific information into clear, compelling consumer messaging.

Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting messaging to different customer audiences and marketing channels.

Creative Ideation & Marketing Angles

Research customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying motivations to develop fresh marketing angles.

Brainstorm and pitch creative concepts, unique selling propositions, hooks, and campaign ideas.



Analyze competitor messaging, market trends, customer reviews, and consumer behavior to identify new opportunities.

Collaborate with the performance marketing and creative teams to develop and test new concepts.

Identify opportunities to reposition existing products through new messaging, storytelling, and value propositions.

Performance & Optimization

Develop copy variations for A/B testing across
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Use performance metrics such as conversion rates, click-through rates, revenue per recipient, and average order value to improve messaging.

Collaborate with marketing teams to identify underperforming content and develop stronger alternatives.

Continuously refine copy based on campaign performance, customer feedback, and business objectives.

Ensure all supplement marketing claims align with brand guidelines and applicable advertising regulations.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience in direct response copywriting, preferably within DTC, eCommerce, supplements, health, wellness, or beauty.

Proven experience writing high-converting
 campaigns, landing pages, and sales funnels.

Strong understanding of consumer psychology, persuasion, storytelling, and conversion rate optimization.

Ability to independently develop creative marketing angles and campaign concepts.

Experience researching target audiences, competitors, and customer pain points.

Ability to interpret marketing performance data and use insights to improve copy.

Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.



Familiarity with FTC/FDA supplement advertising guidelines is a plus.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who does more than execute a writing brief. We want a creative problem-solver who can bring new ideas to the table.

Someone who can look at a product, understand the customer, identify what makes it compelling, and develop messaging that makes people want to buy.



You should be comfortable testing unconventional angles, challenging existing messaging, and continuously looking for ways to improve marketing performance.
