About the Role



We are an Australian trades and labour hire company looking for an experienced Filipino professional to join our growing team.



This is an all-rounder position involving recruitment, cold calling, business development, client communication and administration.



We're looking for someone confident, professional and capable of working independently, with the opportunity to grow into a long-term role.



Key Responsibilities



Cold call Australian construction companies to generate new business.



Build relationships with clients and manage enquiries.



Source, screen and recruit construction workers and tradespeople.



Manage candidate availability, placements and follow-ups.



Maintain client and candidate records in our recruitment CRM.



Write professional
s and assist with general administration.



Essential Requirements



Exceptional spoken English with native-level fluency, clear pronunciation and excellent communication skills. This is our highest priority.



Experience in Australian construction recruitment or labour hire.



Proven cold calling, sales and client communication experience.



Strong written English and professional
 skills.



Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.



Experience using recruitment CRMs.



Confident, organised, reliable and able to work independently.



Highly Regarded



Experience recruiting Australian carpenters, labourers and tradespeople.



Knowledge of the Australian construction industry.



Experience with Tracker RMS.



Previous experience dealing directly with Australian clients.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your relevant experience in Australian construction recruitment and cold calling.



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience in English.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Your availability to start.



A voice recording is required for your application to be considered.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with our business and become a valued long-term member of our team.

title: Recruitment & Staffing Coordinator — Home Care
description:
**Recruitment & Staffing Coordinator — Home Care**



Manage caregiver sourcing, resume screening, interviews, and onboarding coordination. Verify qualifications and certifications, such as CNA, HHA, CPR, and First Aid, including validity and expiration dates.



Handle daily scheduling, caregiver call-outs, and urgent shift coverage. Use **AxisCare, WellSky, and applicant tracking systems (ATS)** to manage schedules and candidate records. Source applicants through Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, and social media, maintain a qualified talent pool, and provide daily client updates.



Schedule

Mon-Fri 10:30-5:30 EST

Rate: $7/hr



REQUIREMENTS"

Send me your introduction video  that was recently made and not a year ago

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
About Haulla

Haulla, a smart waste collection service by Ecube Labs, operates in major U.S. markets including Dallas, Houston, Austin, Denver, and Chicago — with plans for further expansion across North America. We help small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. find better, more affordable waste solutions.



What You'll Do

The Customer Onboarding Specialist takes charge of the final stage of sales by spearheading the entire activation process and facilitating a seamless transition, ultimately converting prospects into Haulla customers. Furthermore, to deliver an exceptional service experience, they serve as the primary point of contact—clearly identifying customer needs, conducting thorough verification, and overseeing service implementation to ensure long-term retention.



What We're Looking for

- This is a full-time remote position

- Available to work during U.S. business hours (7 AM–3 PM PST), Monday to Friday.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills

- Native-level English fluency

- Familiarity in CRM tool (e.g., HubSpot) is a plus

- Experience in Sales

- A proactive mindset with a strong drive to go the extra mile to achieve results



What You’ll Need (System Requirements)

- A desktop or laptop computer

- A quiet home workspace

- A noise-cancelling headset



Compensation

- Base salary plus performance-based bonuses 

- probationary period: $4/h + incentives up to $200

- After probationary period: $4/h + unlimited incentives
